name: Affections of the Goddess
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies the following effects on Achilles- 1. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is reduced by 50%; if NP, 25%. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 3. Applies Debuff ResUp for 1◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 50%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Akhilleus Kosmos: The Miniature World Enclosed by the Azure Sky
system: (Passive) Used when Achilles Moves when Unmounted. If Achilles intends to Move onto an occupied Panel, the Unit occupying said panel is forced to Move backward until Achilles stops Moving in that direction. If the Unit does not or cannot vacate those panels, that Unit is forcefully Moved to one of the panels to its sides, and receives damage equivalent to a Normal Attack from Achilles (Base Attack (STR) is used). (Non-damaging) Once, when Achilles or any allied Unit within a 2 panel area of himself is targeted/is within Range of an AoE Noble Phantasm of Rank A and above, Akhilleus Kosmos can be used. Negate all damage and effects of that Noble Phantasm in a 5x5 panel area around Achilles. After that, Akhilleus Kosmos is broken; all its effects are lost and cannot be used for the rest of the game.

name: Andreias Amarantos: Amaranth of the Brave
system: (Passive/Non-damaging) Heroism's Eternal Man. All damage received is reduced as follows- 1. Unit without Divinity: Receives 0 damage 2. Unit with E-Rank Divinity: All Total Damage received is reduced by 50% (halved). 3. Unit with D-Rank Divinity: All Total Damage received is reduced by 25%. 4. Unit with C-Rank Divinity and above: Receives normal damage. The effect of Andreias Amarantos is lost if Achilles' Heel is damaged.

name: Diatrekhōn Astēr Lonkhē: Spear-tip of the Star Traversing the Skies
system: Meteor Spear (Non-damaging) Duel Field. Can only be used when Unmounted. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Achilles challenges the targeted Unit to a duel. The Noble Phantasm is only activated if the opposing Unit (player) agrees to the duel, and all conditions of the duel (including defeat) must be decided and agreed on by the two involved parties. When this Noble Phantasm is activated, Achilles and the opposing Unit are enclosed within a 5x5 panel area where they are standing on the game board. Then, both Units will continuously duel (Combat) until one Unit is 'defeated' as per the terms of the duel; and when the 'defeat' occurs, the NP is deactivated. No Units can enter the NP area or interfere with the duel, even with Command Spells; the involved Units are not allowed to leave the NP area until the defeat occurs as well. Also, Luck Check cannot be used by the involved Units; and all buffs and debuffs that were caused by Units not involved in the duel are negated for the duration of the duel. This Noble Phantasm cannot be used on Female Units and/or Units with at least 3 Parameters one Rank lower than Achilles'. Additionally, this Noble Phantasm cannot be used on the following 3 Servants: Hector, Chiron, Penthesilea. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Dromeus Komētēs: Comet Form
system: (Passive) Runner Comet. Is only in effect when Unmounted. Has the following effects- 1. Has the effects of Passive 1 of Riding (Double Move). 2. The value of Evade rolls are reduced by 4.

name: Achilles' Heel
system: Whenever Achilles participates in a Combat Phase while Unmounted, the enemy Unit has a chance to Attack Achilles' Heel during its Attack (the player states whether the AU performs a Heel Attack or not). Achilles cannot Block Heel Attacks. If Achilles Failed to Evade the Heel Attack, the percentage chance of succeeding are as follows- 1. Attack from the Front: 0% 2. Attack from the Sides: 5% 3. Attack from the Back: 10% a) +5% if the AU's Agility is equal to or higher than Achilles'. b) +5% if the Attack was performed at a Range of 3 or higher. c) +5% if Combat was initiated by the AU (i.e. not a Counter Attack). d) −10% if the Attack was an AoE Attack. e) +10% if Achilles was Attacked from within the Fog of War. f) A Luck Check can be used to increase the success chance by 25%. If the AU's Heel Attack fails, Achilles successfully Evades the Attack. If it succeeded, Achilles receives damage that ignores all Defensive Buffs and damage reducing effects, and his Heel is damaged permanently.

name: Runner Comet
system: (Active) Can only be used when Unmounted and at the start of a Combat Phase. Restore 3 Agility, then applies N.Atk Up for that Turn, Normal Attack damage dealt is increased by 30%; and Crit DmUp for that Turn, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. Cannot be used if Achilles is affected by Skill Seal or NP Seal. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Troias Tragōidia: Tempestuous Immortal Chariot
system: Troy's Tragedy. (Passive) Riding Attack damage is increased by 25%, does not affect NP. At the end of any Turn where Achilles Acts while Mounted, his Master loses 25 Health. (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. This NP is used in the form of a Riding Attack, with a distance of 13 panels. First restores X Agility and applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by X0%; if NP (X−1)0%; X=(the amount of remaining MOV Achilles has divided by 2). Deals 4x damage. Then, applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by Y0%, Y=number of Units successfully hit by this NP. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Freezing Summertime
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Invuln for ⅓◈ Turns. 2. Applies BuffRemoval ResUp for ⅓◈ Turns, the chance of having buffs removed from herself is reduced by 100%. 3. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, Crit Chance is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Ice Block Launcher・Absolute Killer Baseball: Underthrow Freeze Sinker
system: Base Attack (STR) is used. Range+3 for the Combat Process. Has the Aim effect. Deals 3x damage with a 5% chance of inflicting Instakill for each panel between Anastasia and the DU. Ice damage. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns.

name: Ice Bucket Challenge for You
system: Attack Skill. Range=2. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Deals Water damage. Then, has the following effects- 1. Has a 20% chance of inflicting Slow for 1◈ Turns. 2. Applies the 'Soaked' effect. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Rock Snowball
system: (Passive) Anastasia's Normal Attacks at a Range of 3 or higher have a 10% chance of inflicting Bleed for ½◈ Turns. *Remember kids, don't throw snowballs with rocks in them!*

name: Shvibzik (Summer)
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 3 Luck. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. 3. NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈+⅔◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Snegleta・Snegurochka: Summer Snow, Beautiful Drops of Hoarfrost
system: Dreaming Crater・Snow Maiden. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range+1 for the Combat Process. First, inflict Def Dwn (A) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 30%, and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. Then, deals 3.5x damage and inflicts Skill Seal for ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.

name: Full Acceleration: Spirit Eyes
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Aim for 1◈ Turns. 2. Applies Crit Up (Viy) for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance of Attacks which use Base Attack (MAG) is increased by 50%; if NP, 20%. 3. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. 4. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP Damage dealt is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Swimsuit!
system: (Passive) All Total Water Damage taken is reduced by 50% including NP.

name: Watermelon Splitting Master
system: (Passive) When Anastasia performs a Normal Attack at a Range of 1 to 2 while inflicted with Blind, it does not have a chance of Missing; and instead it gains the Pierce & Ignore Def effects, also the DU's Evade roll is increased by 4 if it Evades the Attack. (Active) Used at the start of a Combat Phase when initiating an Attack. Anastasia gains Blind until the end of the Combat Process. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Appreciation of the Arts
system: (Passive 1) When a NP with the 'Artistic' Attribute is used within a 3 panel area of this Unit, it has a chance of learning the True Name of that NP (the information of that NP is copied to your Notebook). (Passive 2) All damage taken from a NP with the 'Artistic' Attribute is reduced. Note: NP with the 'Artistic' Attribute would be any Noble Phantasm involving or related to artistic, literary, musical creations.

name: Agni Gandiva: Flame God's Yell
system: Cannot be used on the same Turn as Mana Burst (Flames), or if Mana Burst (Flames) is in Cooldown. Base Attack (STR) and Base Attack (MAG) combined (e.g. BA=325) is used, effect of Magic Resistance is halved. Range=7. Has the Aim effect. Deals 4x damage and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns on the DU. Fire damage. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns. When Agni Gandiva is used, Mana Burst (Flames) also enters Cooldown.

name: The Awarded Hero
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈+⅓◈ Turns. 2. Applies Regen for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, Health is restored by 15% of its maximum value at the end of his Turn, at the end of any Turn he Acts, and at the end of the Round. 3. Applies Area CritUp (Awarded) for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 10% for himself; and 5% for other allied Units within a 2 panel area of this Unit. 4. Applies NP Regen for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Clairvoyance (Bowman)
system: (Passive) When Arjuna performs a Normal Attack at a Range of 3 or higher, the DU has a 90% chance of using Evade- when Evading. Otherwise, the Combat Process proceeds as normal. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 25%. 2. Applies Debuff Immune for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, does not affect Instakill/Death/Erase. 3. Applies Range Up (Clairvoyance) for 1◈ Turns, Range is increased by 1 panel, does not stack. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Fated Rivals of the Mahabharata
system: (Passive) If Karna is in the opposing Faction and within Range of Arjuna, they will only Attack each other. Arjuna's Master can spend one Command Spell to negate this effect for 1◈ Turns, but it will only affect Arjuna.

name: Mana Burst (Flames)
system: (Active) This Skill is used when Arjuna performs a Normal Attack. For that Combat Process, Arjuna's Base Attack used is his BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (e.g. BA=325). Has a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns on the DU. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Fire Damage. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Roar of the Flame God.

name: Pashupata: Raised Arm of the Destruction God
system: Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Arjuna's Range for 4x damage plus 100. Has a 30% chance of inflicting Death on the DU. For every Rank in Divinity the DU has, the chance of inflicting Death is increased by 10% (example: Divinity Rank C, 30% + 30% = 60%). Then, inflicts Def Dwn on all affected Units for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 40%. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Roar of the Flame God
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 3 Luck. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 3. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 20%. 4. Applies the 'Agni' buff for 1◈ Turns, 3 times, Normal Attacks deal Fire damage with a 30% chance of inflicting Burn for 1◈ Turns; does not apply to & is not consumed by Attacks used with Mana Burst (Flames). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Mana Burst (Flames).

name: Avalon (place in Master)
system: (Avalon, Method 2) Used on her Master, when Arturia is directly next to her Master and they are both in their Home Base. Arturia places [Avalon] inside her Master (this counts as Arturia giving the Item to her Master); both Arturia and her Master cannot Attack on the same Turn, and cannot Move after.

name: Avalon (take back)
system: (Avalon, Method 2) Arturia reobtains [Avalon] from inside her Master, by the same process: directly next to her Master, both in their Home Base; neither can Attack on the same Turn, and neither can Move after.

name: Avalon: The Everdistant Utopia
system: (Non-damaging) When Arturia is summoned, roll an eight-sided die. If an 8 is rolled, she is summoned with the [Avalon] Item. Can be used in two different methods- 1. Can only be used 8 full Rounds after the start of the game (i.e. from the 9th Round onwards). Used when Arturia or an allied Unit directly next to Arturia is Attacked. Negate all damage and effects of that Attack including NP, on the Unit who was Attacked. If it was an AoE Attack, this NP affects all Units within a 1 panel area of Arturia. Using this NP does not reduce her Master's Health as a cost. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns. 2. Placing it inside her Master: Avalon (place).

name: Charisma
system: (Passive) All damage dealt by other allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself is increased by 20 including NP. This effect is negated if this Unit has Atk Up (Charisma) or is inflicted with Skill Seal.

name: Dragon's Reactor Core
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. 2. Applies NP DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 30%. 3. Applies the DRC buff for the rest of the Round at the end of the Turn this Skill used, all damage dealt by Normal Attacks is increased by 25%. Normal Attacks performed with Mana Burst are not affected by the DRC buff. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Mana Burst.

name: Excalibur: Sword of Promised Victory
system: (Passive) When Invisible Air is deactivated, Arturia's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance of dealing 25 extra Light damage to the DU, 50 if the DU has the 'Dark' Attribute. (Active) Can only be used when Invisible Air is deactivated. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x6 or 6x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Arturia for 4x damage plus 200. Has a 40% chance of inflicting Blind for 1◈ Turns. Deals extra damage to Units with the 'Dark' Attribute, damage dealt is further increased by 100%. Light damage. Then, Excalibur's NP Cooldown is reduced by X◈ Turns, X being (the number of Units affected by this NP * ⅓). Cooldown: 7◈+⅔◈ Turns. After Excalibur is used, Invisible Air is deactivated for 2◈ Turns after its use.

name: Instinct
system: (Passive 1) When this Unit is Attacked, it has a 70% chance of automatically Evading the Attack. If Instinct fails, the Combat Process proceeds as normal. If the Attack is a Noble Phantasm, the chance is 35% instead. (Passive 2) Crit Chance is increased by 10%. This Skill is negated while inflicted with Skill Seal.

name: Invisible Air: Bounded Field of the Wind King
system: (Passive/Activation) Can be activated or deactivated at any time, once per Turn. When Arturia is summoned, she starts the game with Invisible Air active. Has the following effects while Active- 1. Whenever Arturia performs a Normal Attack and the DU Evades, the DU's Evade roll is increased by 1 if its AGI Rank is higher than Arturia's, and is increased by 2 if its AGI Rank is equal or lower than Arturia's. 2. The magnitude of Crit Dwn is halved on Arturia. If Invisible Air is deactivated while Arturia is affected by Crit Dwn effects, the magnitude of the Crit Dwn effects are un-halved.

name: Knight of Utopia
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself with the 'Round Table' Attribute, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 3. Applies Dmg Boost (Utopia) for 1◈ Turns to herself- After Arturia performs 3 Attacks, her next Normal Attack deals 200% extra damage, then this buff is removed. 4. Applies the Utopia buff for 1◈ Turns to herself, whenever Arturia performs a successful Attack, NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns for every Unit successfully hit by that Attack. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. This Skill is categorized as 'Charisma'.

name: Mana Burst
system: (Active) This Skill is used when Arturia performs a Normal Attack. For that Combat Process, Arturia's Base Attack used is her BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (BA=325); and for that Combat Phase, Arturia's Evade Rolls are reduced by 2. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Can be used while on Cooldown, but she has to be within her Master's Servant Range (ZON) and her Master loses 20 Health; using it in this way does not reset Cooldown. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Dragon's Reactor Core.

name: Radiant Road
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Reduce Arturia's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns. 2. Apply S.Crit Up to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Arturia for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 3. Apply the Radiant buff for 1◈ Turns to herself, all other allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself gain the effects of her 'Instinct' Skill. Note: If Arturia is inflicted with Skill Seal, Instinct will still have no effect for all Units. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King
system: Range=3. Deals 300 damage to 1 target. Not affected by any damage modifying effects on Arturia. Wind damage. Strike Air deactivates Invisible Air for 1◈ Turns after its use. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns.

name: Vivian's Blessing
system: (Passive) Arturia receives no negative effects from being within a Waterside area.

name: Avyssos of Labrys
system: (Active) Applies Crit Up (+60% Crit Chance), N.Atk Up (+40% Normal Attack damage) and Bleed Atk (Normal Attacks have a 10% chance of inflicting Bleed for 1◈ Turns), each for 1◈ Turns.

name: Chaos Labyrinthos: Eternally Unchanging Labyrinth
system: (Non-damaging) Creates a 9x9 Labyrinth around Asterios; 11x11 if the Region is Greece. Asterios gains MOV +4 inside. Enemies inside suffer Atk Dwn and Def Dwn on activation, have their MOV reduced by 2 (minimum 2), and must roll to escape. Units outside and inside cannot reach each other at all. Lasts for 4◈ Turns, extendable by 2◈ more for 200 of Asterios' Health, repeatably. Ends at the end of the Turn if Asterios is defeated.

name: Monstrous Strength
system: (Active) Used at the start of a Damage Step when performing an Attack. STR Damage dealt by that Attack is increased by 100%; if NP, 50%.

name: Natural Monster
system: (Passive) The source of Asterios' inhuman STR and END. (Active) Applies Off.Debuff ResUp for 1◈ Turns (chance of being inflicted by Offensive Debuffs reduced by 100%) and Def Up for 1◈ Turns (all damage taken reduced by 40%; if NP, 20%).

name: Avalon: The Everdistant Utopia
system: (Non-damaging) Used when this Unit is Attacked. Reduce the damage taken by X% including NP, and negate up to Y additional negative effects (i.e. debuffs) from that Attack, this Master's pick: Arturia's Master with Arturia at most 3 panels away: X=80%, Y=3. Arturia's Master with Arturia farther or defeated: X=60%, Y=2. Any other Master: X=40%, Y=1. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.

name: Avalon (pass to a Master)
system: Give [Avalon] to another allied Master directly next to this one, both in their Home Base, neither having Attacked this Turn. Neither can Attack on the same Turn, nor Move after.

name: [Avalon]
system: While [Avalon] is inside a Master: a. Max Health is increased by 100; Max Luck is increased by 2, and Base Attack (STR & MAG) is increased by 50. b. At the end of its Turn, at the end of any Turn it Acts, and at the end of a Damage Step whenever it takes damage, its Health is restored by 20% of its maximum value and Agility by 2 if Arturia is at most 3 panels away; 10% and 1 if she is farther or defeated; 5% and 1 in any other Master. c. If it would be defeated while its Health is at 10% of its maximum value or higher (5% once Arturia is defeated, or in any other Master), it is not defeated and its Health drops to 1. d. It is immune to Death and Erase. e. It cannot be Overpowered. [Avalon] cannot be Stolen or dropped.

name: Cursed Poison Dragonfire
system: (Active) Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to itself for 3x and inflicts Poison, then inflicts Crit DmDwn for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is reduced by 30%. Categorized as Noble Phantasm. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Charisma
system: (Passive) All damage dealt by other allied Units within a 2 panel area of this Unit is increased by a flat figure, including NP. This effect is negated if this Unit has Atk Up (Charisma) or is inflicted with Skill Seal. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up (Charisma) for 1◈ Turns to this Unit, all damage dealt by allied Units within a 2 panel area of it is increased by a percentage; a smaller one if NP.

name: Antares Snipe: Heavenly Scorpion Single-Shot
system: (Active) Can only be used at Night; and can only be used once per Night Round. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range=5. First, removes all Defensive Buffs from the DU, then deals 2x damage plus 100; then inflicts Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 40%. Damage dealt to Units with the [Earth] Attribute is further increased by 150%. When this NP is used, Chiron's Master loses Health equivalent to if a Rank E Noble Phantasm was used instead. If possible, this NP can be used to target a specific 'body part' or 'weak point' on the DU (i.e. Unit with the 'Vital Spot' Attribute); if used in this way, the chance of hitting that specific target is increased by 75%. Note: Can only be used during 'Night' Rounds as dictated by the game state (not from 'Night' created by effects such as 'Darkness' Terrain). Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. (Trigger) Automatically activates when Chiron is defeated. ⅓◈ Turns after Chiron was defeated, the Active effect of Antares Snipe is automatically used on the Unit who defeated him at the start of the Turn. Chiron's ex-Master does not lose Health from this effect. If ⅓◈ Turns after Chiron was defeated is a Day Round, then this effect automatically activates at the start of the next Night Round.

name: Clairvoyance
system: (Passive 1) When Chiron uses a Normal Attack at a Range of 3 or higher, the DU rolls a ten-sided die. The DU has a 90% chance of using Evade- when Evading. Otherwise, the Combat Process proceeds as normal. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 35%. Also applies Range Up (Clairvoyance) for 1◈ Turns, Range is increased by 1 (does not stack). Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. (Passive 2) Whenever Passive 1 of this Skill is triggered, reduce the Cooldown of this Skill by ⅓◈ Turns.

name: Consecration of Eternal Life
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Chiron. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 50%; and applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. Then, Chiron's Health is reduced by 5% of its maximum value (cannot drop below 1 in this way). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Eye of the Mind (True)
system: (Passive) Evade rolls are reduced by 3, does not affect non-Evade Agility Checks. Upon a successful Evade, reduce the Cooldown of this Skill by ⅓◈ Turns. (Active) Used at the start of a Combat Process when Attacked. Applies Dodge for ⅓◈ Turns and applies Def Up for ⅔◈ Turns, all damage taken is reduced by 25%; if NP, 15%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Great Sage of Centaurs
system: (Active) Used during your Turn, Chiron switches between Human Form and Centaur Form. Can only be used once per Round. (Passive) In Centaur Form, MOV is increased by 2, but value of Evade Rolls are increased by 2. Additionally, Chiron gains the 'Passenger Seat' ability and loses the 'Humanoid' Attribute while in Centaur Form. Passenger Seat: The Servant's Master can Move together with its Servant; after Moving, both Servant and Master must be in the same orientation/position prior to the Move. Counts as only Moving one Unit. Can be combined with Riding Attack.

name: Wisdom of Divine Gift
system: When Chiron is Summoned, he is given a list of Skills (preferably Rank B to Rank A) that must have an Active effect, of all other Servants on the field. He can then select three of them, and use their effects as effects of this Skill. Rank EX Skills cannot be copied. Neither can Skills a Servant is physically born with, Skills that are part of their body, or Skills unique to the Hero — Natural Body, 'Mystic Eye' Skills, 'Mana Burst' Skills, Kishu no Ma, Affections of the Holy Grail. Each copied Skill: Cooldown 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if another copied Skill is on Cooldown.

name: Wisdom of Divine Gift (Teach)
system: Chiron is able to teach one of the copied Skills to another Servant. Both Masters must agree to this teaching, and both Chiron and the learning Servant must be directly next to each other. The teaching process lasts for 1◈ Turns; Chiron and the learning Servant cannot Act until the teaching process is complete, and the teaching process is cancelled if interrupted (e.g. enemy Servant Attack).

name: Rune Magic: ᚨ (Ansuz)
system: Ansuz. Damage Spell. Range=3. Deals damage to an enemy Unit and has a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Gáe Bolg: Barbed Spear that Pierces with Death
system: {M} Range=3. Base Attack (STR) is used. Has the Aim effect. When this NP is used, the DU performs a Luck Check. If Failed, the DU is inflicted with Instakill and Curse (Bolg). If the Luck Check succeeded or Instakill was not inflicted, this NP deals 3.5x damage and inflicts Curse (Bolg). Curse (Bolg) is separate from normal Curse, does not stack, and is Unremovable; when Cú Chulainn is defeated, Curse (Bolg) is removed from all affected Units. Chance of this NP inflicting Instakill on Units with Invuln is reduced by 50%, while chance of it inflicting Instakill on Units with Anti-Purge is reduced by 100%. The Master's Health cost of using this NP is treated as if a Rank D Noble Phantasm was used. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns. Note: cannot be used if Soaring Spear that Strikes with Death is on Cooldown.

name: Gáe Bolg: Soaring Spear that Strikes with Death
system: {R} Range=4. BA(STR) and half of BA(MAG) combined (e.g. BA=200) is used. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Range for 3.5x damage plus 100. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns. Note: cannot be used if Barbed Spear that Pierces with Death is on Cooldown.

name: Protection from Arrows
system: (Passive) Cú will automatically Evade any {Ranged} Attacks (arrows, firearms, thrown weapons, magic projectiles, etc) including Noble Phantasms from his Front and Sides; when he receives an aforementioned Attack from Behind (i.e. the 3 panels behind him) and he Evades, the Evade roll is reduced by 2. Does not apply to AoE Attacks. Has no effect if this Unit is affected by Skill Seal.

name: Rune Magic
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Roll a four-sided die and apply the corresponding effect. Then, you can apply one more effect of your choice other than the one selected by the die. 1. Applies the Tiwaz buff for 1◈ Turns, his Rank of Magic Resistance is increased by 1 Rank. 2. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is reduced by 25%; if NP, 15%. 3. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 25%; if NP, 15%. 4. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Shoal of Four Branches
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, when Cú is defeated he is revived with 25% of his Max Health. 2. Applies Atk Up (Redbranch) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by (20+X)%; if NP, this value is halved. X is as follows- For every 10% of Health Cú is missing, X increases by 10 (e.g. Cú's Health is 457/1000, so X=50). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Karakuri Genpō: Dongyū (Concealment)
system: Mechanical Illusory Art: Bull Swallowing - Evil Wind Death Storm. Can be used in 2 different methods- 1. Used on a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Danzō. Applies the effects of Presence Concealment — Rank: C+ to all affected Units for 2◈ Turns. The effect is lost after the Skill duration ends. Cooldown: 5◈+⅓◈ Turns. Presence Concealment — Rank: C+: as Presence Concealment, with the DU's Evade Roll increased by 2 and a 35% chance of being discovered.

name: Karakuri Genpō: Dongyū (Storm)
system: Mechanical Illusory Art: Bull Swallowing - Evil Wind Death Storm. Can be used in 2 different methods- 2. Base Attack (STR) is used. Hits a 1x5 or 5x1 panel area in any direction (if diagonal, 1x4 or 4x1) next to Danzō for 3x damage plus 100. Damage dealt is further increased by 200% (tripled) to Units with the 'Demon' or 'Beast' Attribute. Wind damage. Then, applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. Cooldown: 5◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Karakuri Genpō: Fubatsu
system: (Active) Mechanical Illusion: Steadfast. Used on your Turn. Used on an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of herself. Applies Invuln for 1◈ Turns, 3 times; and applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 25%. Cannot be used if Kawarimi and/or Kirihanasu is on Cooldown. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Karakuri Ninpou: Fuuma Funshindan
system: Attack Skill. Range=4. Hits a 3x3 panel area for 50% extra damage and a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Can be used when Presence Concealment is Active, has a 50% chance of deactivating Presence Concealment when used.

name: Ninjutsu: Harisenbon
system: (Active) Thousand Needles. Used on your Turn. Used on an enemy Unit within a 2 panel area of herself. Has a 50% chance of inflicting Disable for 1◈+⅓◈ Turns. If Disable fails, inflicts Slow for 1◈+⅓◈ Turns. Regardless of which was inflicted, the DU is also inflicted Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 10%. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Tobikatō or Funshindan. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Can be used when Presence Concealment is Active, has a 50% chance of deactivating Presence Concealment when used.

name: Karakuri Genpō: Kawarimi
system: (Active) Mechanical Illusion: Substitution. Used when Attacked, or an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of Danzō is Attacked. 1. If Danzō is the one being Attacked, she can swap herself with any other Unit within a 2 panel area of herself except the AU. The Combat Process continues as normal. 2. If the allied Unit is the one being Attacked, she can swap herself with that allied Unit. The Combat Process continues as normal. Cannot be used if Fubatsu and/or Kirihanasu is on Cooldown. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Karakuri Genpō: Kirihanasu
system: (Active) Mechanical Illusion: Detachment. Used when Danzō is Attacked and receives fatal damage (i.e. Health would be reduced to 0). First, the Player privately informs the GM that it wants to use this Skill. Instead of taking damage, the player Moves Danzō to another panel on the board as per her Move, and Presence Concealment is Activated, regardless of Cooldown; the GM makes a note of the panel on the game board where Danzō has Moved to. Meanwhile, the opposing Player is shown and informed that Danzō has been defeated. From this point on, an invisible (Presence Concealed) Danzō is being secretly controlled by her Player by informing the GM of her Moves; she does not apply to the number of Units that Move during a Turn in this case. The Presence Concealment activated by Kirihanasu is Active until Danzō Attacks, and her survived existence is revealed to all other players at this point. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns, and Danzō's Health must have been restored back to above 75% of its maximum value since using Kirihanasu.

name: Subversive Activities
system: (Active) Used on your Turn. Affects all enemy Units within a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Danzō. Inflicts Atk Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is reduced by 10%; if NP, 5%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Can be used when Presence Concealment is Active.

name: Synthetic Limbs (Doll)
system: Not just limbs, her whole body is a karakuri doll. (Passive) Danzō is Immune to Sap/Bleed. (Active) Used during your Turn. Restore 3 Agility, and applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅔◈ Turns.

name: Ninjutsu: Tobikatō
system: (Active) Kite Katō. Used on your Turn. Used on an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of herself. Applies Dodge for 1◈ Turns, 3 times; and applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 25%. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Harisenbon or Funshindan. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Youjutsu Zanhou・Yuugao
system: Black Arts Decapitation Method: Moonflower. Can only be used by expending a Command Spell. Range=3. Used on an enemy Unit. Has the Pierce effect. Deals damage equivalent to the DU's current Health that has the Ignore Def effect, and inflicts Instakill if damage is dealt. This NP misses/fails if the DU Successfully Evades; this NP can only be Evaded with a Luck Check (Lucky Evasion). Cooldown: 5◈ Turns.

name: Guardians of Navigation
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of itself (and its linked partner if it is out of the Skill's Range). Has the following effects- 1. Applies NP DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 15%. 2. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 15%; if NP, 5%. 3. Applies Debuff Immune for 1◈ Turns, 1 time, the next debuff inflicted on the affected Unit is negated, does not affect Instakill, Death, and Erase. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Mana Burst (Light/Ancient)
system: (Active) This Skill is used when performing a Normal Attack. First, either restore 2 Agility and 2 Luck to Castor; or restore 1 Agility and 1 Luck to both Castor and Pollux. Then, for that Combat Process, the Base Attack used is Castor's BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (BA=300). Not affected by Magic Resistance. Light damage (half). This Attack has a 50% chance of inflicting Blind on the DU for 1◈ Turns. Then, reduce Castor's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Mana Burst (Light/Ancient)
system: (Active) This Skill is used when performing a Normal Attack. First, either restore 2 Agility and 2 Luck to Pollux; or restore 1 Agility and 1 Luck to both Castor and Pollux. Then, for that Combat Process, the Base Attack used is Pollux's BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (BA=300). Not affected by Magic Resistance. Light damage (half). This Attack has a 50% chance of inflicting Blind on the DU for 1◈ Turns. Then, apply Evade to Pollux for ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Stars of the Chief God
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies the 'Castor' and 'Pollux' buffs on itself and its linked partner for 1◈ Turns. Has the following effects- 1. 'Pollux' buff: When the affected Unit performs a Normal Attack that does not Crit, apply S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of itself (and its partner if it is out of the Skill's Range), Crit Chance is increased by 10%. 2. 'Castor' buff: When the affected Unit performs a Normal Attack that is a Crit, reduce the Unit's NP Cooldown by 1 Turn. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Twin God's Divine Core
system: (Passive 1) All damage dealt is increased by 80 including NP. (Passive 2) Whenever Castor performs a successful Normal Attack, he has a 5% chance of reducing his NP Cooldown by 1 Turn at the end of the Damage Step. This Skill counts as 'Divinity'.

name: Twin God's Divine Core
system: (Passive 1) All damage dealt is increased by 80 including NP. (Passive 2) Pollux's Crit Chance is increased by 5%. This Skill counts as 'Divinity'.

name: Dioscures Tyndaridae: Hymn of the Divine Twins
system: Range=2, measured from either twin: a target within 2 panels of Castor or of Pollux can be chosen. Can only be used when Castor and Pollux are directly next to each other. The Base Attack used is half of Castor's Base Attack (STR) and half of Pollux's Base Attack (STR) combined (BA=150). Deals 3.5x damage that has the Pierce and Ignore Def effects. Then, inflicts Def Dwn (A) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 15% and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack; and also inflicts Def Dwn (C) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 15% and Agility is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. Counts as both Castor and Pollux's Attack for the Turn. The effects of all Skills, buffs and debuffs on both Castor and Pollux are combined when calculating damage for this NP. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.

name: Disengage
system: (Active) Used at the start of a Combat Phase when this Unit is Attacked. The enemy Unit's Attack is cancelled; this Unit may Move, then restores Health and removes debuffs from itself, by its Rank.

name: Beyond the Uncharted
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel range of Drake; or if the Golden Hind is boarded, affects all allied Units upon the Golden Hind. Has the following effects- 1. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 20%. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 3. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 4. Applies the Uncharted buff for 1◈ Turns to Drake, her Detect is increased by 3 panels. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Blazing Golden Rule
system: (Passive) Whenever this Unit performs a Crit, reduce its NP Cooldown by 1 Turn and she has a 15% chance of gaining 1 Galleon Token. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. 3. Applies Ignore Def for 1◈ Turns. 4. Gain 3 Galleon Tokens. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. (Passive) At the end of every full Round, lose 1 Galleon Token.

name: Golden Hind: Wild Hunt
system: (Non-damaging/Passive/Activation) When the Golden Hind is activated, place the 'Golden Hind' token on the field, then place Drake upon it. The Golden Hind's token size is 12 panels (4x3 panels). Enemy Units cannot target Units onboard the Golden Hind for Attacks/Skills/Spells/Noble Phantasms. Drake's Normal Attacks are replaced with Attacks from the Golden Hind. Drake cannot unboard the Golden Hind. Including Drake, it can hold a maximum of nine Units. At the end of every full Round the Golden Hind is Active, Drake's Master loses 50 Health. The Golden Hind is forcefully deactivated at the end of the Round if Drake's Master has 50 Health or less; her Master does not lose Health at the end of the Round in this situation. This effect overwrites the normal Master Health loss when a Servant uses its NP. If an enemy Unit attempts to board the Golden Hind, it rolls a ten-sided die, and boards only on a 10. When the Golden Hind is destroyed/deactivated, all Units onboard it are randomly scattered below it. The Golden Hind cannot be affected by buffs and/or debuffs. If Drake is inflicted with NP Seal, the Golden Hind is immediately deactivated. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns after the Golden Hind is destroyed/deactivated.

name: Golden Wild Hunt: The Night of the Golden Hind and the Storm
system: The Golden Hind's Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 7x3 or 3x7 panel area in the direction the Golden Hind is facing (i.e. where the ship's bow is facing) for 4x damage plus 100. Additionally, Total damage dealt is further increased by 10% for every Galleon Token on herself; however, if she has no Galleon Tokens, Total damage dealt is reduced by 15%. Note: Can be used even if the Golden Hind isn't present/activated; in this case the Range is still the same, just applied to Drake. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Pioneer of the Stars
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Reduces Drake's NP Cooldown by 1◈+⅔◈ Turns; then applies Pierce for 1◈+½◈ Turns; and applies S.Crit Up to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 10%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Voyager of the Storm
system: (Passive) Sails on the Golden Hind.

name: Projection - Caladbolg II: The Fake Spiral Sword
system: Range+2 for the Combat Process. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Target an enemy Unit. This NP hits a 3x3 panel area around the targeted Unit for 4x damage, and has the Pierce effect on the targeted Unit. EMIYA cannot be within the NP area. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns.

name: Clairvoyance
system: (Passive) When EMIYA performs a Normal Attack at a Range of 3 or higher, the DU has an 80% chance of using Evade- when Evading. Otherwise, the Combat Process proceeds as normal.

name: Eye of the Mind (True) EX
system: (Passive 1) Cannot normally be used unless EMIYA's Health is less than 20% of its maximum value. (Passive 2) Upon a successful Evade, reduce the Cooldown of this Skill by ⅓◈ Turns. (Active) Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Process when Attacked- 1. Applies Dodge for ⅓◈ Turns. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. 3. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is reduced by 30%; if NP, 15%. 4. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself, Crit Chance is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Eye of the Mind (True)
system: (Passive 1) Upon a successful Evade, reduce the Cooldown of this Skill by ⅓◈ Turns. (Active) Used at the start of a Combat Process when Attacked. Applies Dodge to EMIYA for ⅔◈ Turns and applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is reduced by 20%; if NP, 10%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. (Passive 2) While EMIYA's Health is less than 20% of its maximum value, this Skill changes from Rank B to Rank EX.

name: Hawkeye
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Crit Up (Hawkeye) for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 50% at a Range of 3 or higher, and applies Crit DmUp (Hawkeye) for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 100% at a Range of 3 or higher. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Projection - Hrunting: Hound of the Red Plains
system: Range+3 for the Combat Process. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hrunting has the Aim effect. Deals 4x damage. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Cannot be used on a Unit directly next to EMIYA. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns.

name: Projection - Kanshou & Bakuya
system: (Passive) Used when EMIYA performs a Normal Attack at a Range of 2 or lower. When Kanshou & Bakuya are used in Combat, EMIYA's Magic Resistance Rank is increased by one Rank for the rest of that Turn (D to C: MAG damage from a MAG Rank of up to C is negated, otherwise MAG damage taken is reduced by 30%; chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 15%). The effect of 'Kanshou & Bakuya' is negated while 'Overedge' is on Cooldown.

name: Magecraft
system: (Passive 1) Allows the use of Thaumaturgy Spells. (Passive 2) Whenever EMIYA uses a Thaumaturgy Spell, apply Range Up (Hawkeye) (Hawkeye) for 1◈ Turns, Range is increased by 1. Does not stack, but duration is extended if reapplied.

name: Projection - Kanshou & Bakuya: Overedge
system: Attack Skill. During the Combat Process this Skill is used, the effects of 'Kanshou & Bakuya' extend to Normal Attacks at a Range of 3 or lower. EMIYA performs 2 Normal Attacks in a row, damage dealt by each Normal Attack is increased by 50%. Counts as EMIYA's Attack for the Turn. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. Categorized as Noble Phantasm. The effect of 'Kanshou & Bakuya' is negated while this Skill is on Cooldown.

name: Thaumaturgy: Projection Magic
system: (Passive) A Skill which is the basis of his Noble Phantasms. 'Projection' Skills and NP cannot be used and have no effects if EMIYA is inflicted with Silence. Note: 'Projection' Skills and NP are treated as Thaumaturgy Spells.

name: Thaumaturgy: Reinforcement
system: Spell. Used at the start of a Combat Phase. During this Combat Phase, Normal Attack damage dealt is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns.

name: Projection - Rho Aias: The Seven Rings that Cover the Fiery Heavens
system: (Non-damaging) Used when any allied Unit (including EMIYA) within a 3 panel area of EMIYA is about to be hit by a Noble Phantasm. EMIYA projects Rho Aias to protect the allied Unit(s) from the Noble Phantasm. Rho Aias has 1400 Health, and it will take the damage of the enemy's NP. For every 200 Health Rho Aias loses, EMIYA loses 100 Health. If the AU's NP deals more than 1400 damage, the remaining damage is dealt to the DUs accordingly. However, if the NP is a 'thrown weapon', Rho Aias' Health cannot drop below 1. EMIYA's Health cannot drop below 1 due to Rho Aias being damaged by the AU's NP. Additionally, all Units within a 3x3 panel area around the Unit Rho Aias is protecting also receive the effects of Rho Aias. EMIYA's Master loses Health equivalent to if an EX Rank NP is used. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns, and EMIYA's Health must have been restored back to above half its maximum value at least once since the last usage. Every time Rho Aias is used after its first usage, its Health is restored by half of its current Health.

name: Trace, On
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. If this is not the first time EMIYA has used this Skill in this game, reduce his Health by 5% of its maximum value (cannot drop below 1 in this way). 2. Apply one of the following effects of your choice to EMIYA- Activated Circuits (AC) or Blazing Circuits (BC). 3. Max and current Luck are increased by 5. 4. Restores 5 Agility. 5. Applies Atk Up (Trace) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. If EMIYA uses a Thaumaturgy or Projection Skill/NP while he has the Atk Up (Trace) buff, its duration is extended by ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns. If this Skill is used while EMIYA already has the Atk Up (Trace) buff, its duration is extended instead of stacking. Then, you can choose to swap from AC to BC or vice-versa. Note: EMIYA cannot have both the AC and BC effects at the same time.

name: Thaumaturgy: Tracing
system: Spell. Used during your Turn. Reduce the Cooldowns of 2 different Skills or NP with 'Projection' in its name by 1◈ Turns OR reduce the Cooldown of a Skill/NP with 'Projection' in its name by 2◈ Turns. Then, apply Dmg Boost for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30 including NP. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Unlimited Blade Works: Infinite Creation of Swords
system: Rank: E~A++ (Passive) At the end of every Combat Phase involving EMIYA, he gains 1 Aria. Maximum number of Aria stored is 6. EMIYA cannot gain Aria if he is inflicted with Silence. Silence stops only that: with 6 Aria he can open it while Silenced (ruled 2026-10-14). (Activation) Can only be used by consuming 6 Aria. Affects a 7x7 panel area around EMIYA. All Units within that 7x7 panel area are trapped and unable to leave; Units outside are unable to enter. Within Unlimited Blade Works, EMIYA's Base Attack (STR) is increased by 50. At the start of every Turn, all enemy Servants within Unlimited Blade Works perform an Evade roll. If failed, that Unit receives (25 x 1d4) STR damage; this damage is not affected by any damage modifying effects on EMIYA. Lasts for 2◈ Turns. Enemy Units outside Unlimited Blade Works are unable to Attack Units inside it and vice versa. EMIYA's Master loses Health equivalent to if a B Rank NP is used. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns.

name: Fae Contract
system: (Passive) Debuff Resist is increased by X%. Chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by X%. B+: X = 5. A: X = 10, and it also affects Instakill, Death and Erase.

name: Blasphemy Aesthetic
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all enemy Units within a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gilles. Has the following effects- 1. Inflicts NP DmDwn for 1◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is reduced by 20%. 2. Inflicts Def Dwn (A) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 10%; and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn (B) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 10%; if NP, 20%. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Evil Gaze of the Abyss
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all enemy Units within a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gilles. Has the following effects- 1. Inflicts Terror for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted with Stun from Terror is 40% (40% Terror). 2. Inflicts Curse. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%. 4. Applies Dmg Up (Curse) for 1◈ Turns to himself, all damage dealt to Units inflicted with Curse is increased by 30%. 5. Applies the Gazing buff for 1◈ Turns to himself, Normal Attacks inflict Curse; while Normal Attacks from all Horrors within a 2 panel area of himself have a 50% chance of inflicting Curse. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Prelati's Spellbook: Gigantic Horror
system: Only usable when Gilles' Health is less than 25% of its maximum value. Has a 10% chance of automatically activating when Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed, or when Gilles is defeated without Prelati's Spellbook being destroyed. Transforms himself into a Gigantic Horror. Replace Gilles with the Gigantic Horror, and its new Stats are as follows- Health: 2000. Agility: 0. Luck: Same as Gilles. MOV: 0. Range: 3 panels, 3x3 panel area. Base Attack (STR): 200 (Used when Range<3). Base Attack (MAG): 200 (Used when Range>2). Sustainability: None. Attributes: Dark (Outsider), Large. Detect: Same as Range. When Gilles turns into the Gigantic Horror, its Stats are fully restored to its new values. Territory Creation and Mental Pollution become inactive; Blasphemy Aesthetic is unusable. When Summoning is used, the number of Horrors summoned is doubled. Evil Eye of the Abyss now hits a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to itself. The Gigantic Horror is no longer controlled by Gilles' Master, and Command Spells have no effect; instead the Gigantic Horror takes its Turn during the GM's Turn (i.e. the last Turn of the Round). When the Gigantic Horror Attacks, it always Attacks the nearest Unit. If there are no Units within its Range for 1 full Round, its Range will increase by 1 at the start of the next Round until it has Attacked a Unit, then it will reset.

name: Item Construction
system: See Prelati's Spellbook.

name: Prelati's Spellbook: Textbook of the Sunken Spiral Castle
system: (Passive) The basis for all of Gilles' Spells. Whenever Gilles is Attacked, if the AU's AGI Rank is Rank C or higher, it can instead target Prelati's Spellbook. The options Gilles has are as follows 1. Evade: If Gilles fails to Evade, he has a 20% chance of taking the damage instead of Prelati's Spellbook; otherwise Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed. 2. Block: Gilles takes the damage instead of Prelati's Spellbook. 3. Substitution: If Summoning: Horrors, Summoning: Elder Horror, or Prelati's Spellbook's Active effect is not on Cooldown, choose one of them, it enters Cooldown. If Gilles does this, instead of receiving the Attack, he can Move up to 4 panels; then roll a four-sided die, he summons that number of Horrors around the panel he was previously standing on, with at least one Horror standing on the panel he previously occupied, which is also the Horror that receives the AU's Attack. 4. Luck Check: If successful, Prelati's Spellbook is not destroyed. Can be used after a failed Evade (1). When Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed, Gilles can no longer use Summoning: Horror, Summoning: Elder Horror, or Prelati's Spellbook's Active effect; and all Horrors on the board are immediately destroyed. However, when Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed, Gilles has a 10% chance of transforming into the Gigantic Horror. When Gilles is defeated and Prelati's Spellbook is not destroyed, he has a 10% chance of transforming into the Gigantic Horror. Otherwise, X number of Elder Horrors appear on the panels around him, where X=number of Servants on the board. (Active) [Anti-Army] Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x4 or 4x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gilles for 5x damage; then has the following effects- 1. Reduce the NP Cooldown of all allied Foreigner-class Servants within a 3 panel area of himself by 1◈ Turns. Also affects non-Foreigner Class Servant Units with the 'Existence outside the Domain' Skill or 'Outsider' Attribute, but NP Cooldown is reduced by ½◈ Turns instead. 2. Inflicts Atk Dwn for 1◈ Turns on the DUs, all damage dealt is reduced by 40%; if NP, 20%. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns on the DUs, all damage taken is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: By The Holy Maiden's Side
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has different effects depending on whether Mad Enhancement has been activated due to Prelati's Encouragement- ME not Activated 1. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Lawful' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 3. Applies Heal Up for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Good' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, when an affected Unit has its Health restored, the amount restored is increased by 80%. 4. If there an allied non-Alter Jeanne d'Arc is present on the field, NP Cooldown is reduced by 2◈ Turns. If there is an allied non-Alter Jeanne d'Arc within a 3 panel area of Gilles, NP Cooldown is reduced by 4◈ Turns instead. If said Unit is standing directly next to Gilles, NP Cooldown is reduced by 6◈ Turns instead. ME Activated 1. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Chaotic' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 3. Applies Heal Up for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Evil' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, when an affected Unit has its Health restored, the amount restored is increased by 80%. 4. If there is an allied Jeanne d'Arc Alter present on the field, apply Dmg Boost (Gilles) for 1◈ Turns to himself, all damage dealt by Gilles and his Horrors is increased by 30. If there is an allied Jeanne d'Arc Alter within a 3 panel area of Gilles, 60 instead of 30. If said Unit is standing directly next to Gilles, 90 instead of 30. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Military Tactics
system: (Passive) Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Gilles. All damage received from [Anti-Army] Noble Phantasms is reduced by 25%; all damage dealt by [Anti-Army] Noble Phantasms is increased by 25%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies NP DmUp (nonAA) for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Gilles, NP damage dealt by Noble Phantasms other than [Anti-Army] is increased by 15%. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Triumphal Return of the Holy Maiden.

name: Prelati's Encouragement
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. (Passive) When this Skill is used, Gilles has a 15% chance of permanently activating his Mad Enhancement Skill. Every time this Skill is used after the first usage, activation chance is increased by 15% (max. 90%).

name: Prelati's Spellbook: Textbook of the Sunken Spiral Castle
system: Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is Activated. Allows the use of the Spells Summoning: Horrors and Summoning: Elder Horror.

name: Saint War Order: Rally Upon the Holy Banner and Roar
system: Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is deactivated. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up to himself for 2◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 100%; if NP, 50%. 2. Applies S.Crit Up to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself for ⅔◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn on himself for 2◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 50%. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.

name: Triumphal Return of the Holy Maiden
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies NP DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Gilles, NP damage dealt is increased by 15%. 2. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units with the 'Lawful' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 50%. 3. Applies Overcharge for 1◈ Turns, 1 time to all allied Units with the 'Good' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, the magnitude of all non-damage effects of NP are increased by 20%. 4. If there is an allied Unit with the [Star] Attribute within a 2 panel area of himself, apply S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself, Crit Chance is increased by 10%. 5. Applies Area CritUp for 1◈ Turns to himself, Crit Chance of all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself is increased by 5%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Military Tactics. (Passive) If an allied non-Alter Jeanne d'Arc is present on the field, Effects 1 to 4 affect all allied Units within a 3 panel area of himself instead. However, if Mad Enhancement has been activated due to Prelati's Encouragement, then this effect only activates if there is an allied Jeanne d'Arc Alter on the field.

name: Prelati's Spellbook: Substitution
system: Substitution: If Summoning: Horrors, Summoning: Elder Horror, or Prelati's Spellbook's Active effect is not on Cooldown, choose one of them, it enters Cooldown. If Gilles does this, instead of receiving the Attack, he can Move up to 4 panels; then roll a four-sided die, he summons that number of Horrors around the panel he was previously standing on, with at least one Horror standing on the panel he previously occupied, which is also the Horror that receives the AU's Attack.

name: Channel Marker Soul
system: (Passive 1) Curse Damage taken is halved. (Passive 2) Whenever Gogh is inflicted with Curse or has Curse removed from herself due to the effects of the 'Gogh' buff, reduce her NP Cooldown by 1 Turn for every Stage of Curse inflicted/removed in this way.

name: De Sterrennacht: The Starry Night
system: (Non-damaging) Used during your Turn. First, inflicts Terror for 1◈ Turns to all enemy Units within a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gogh, chance of being inflicted with Stun from Terror is 60%. Then, apply the following effects to all allied Units within a 3 panel area of Gogh- 1. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 100%. 2. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns again to all affected allied Units with the 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 100%. 3. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by X0%; if NP, the value is halved. X=(3+the number of affected allied Units with the 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill excluding herself). 4. Applies Area CritUp for 1◈ Turns to Gogh, Crit Chance of all allied Units within a 2 panel area of the Unit with this buff is increased by 10%. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: Het Gele Huis
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all enemy Units within a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gogh. Has the following effects- 1. Has a 150% chance of inflicting Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 10%. 2. Inflicts Def Dwn (C) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%, and Agility is reduced by 1 whenever this Unit is successfully Attacked. Then, applies the following effects to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself- 1. Applies Evade for 1◈ Turns, 1 time. 2. Applies Regen for 1◈+½◈ Turns, Health is restored by 5% of its maximum value at the end of the Unit's Turn, at the end of a Turn the Unit Acts, and at the end of the Round. 3. Has a 500% chance of inflicting Curse on all affected allied Units. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if 'The Yellow House' is on Cooldown.

name: Imaginary Numbers Arts
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts to self for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, when Gogh is defeated she is revived with 20% of her Max Health. 2. Has a 500% chance of inflicting Curse on herself, 3 times. 3. Reduce Gogh's NP Cooldown by X Turns, where X=(⅓◈ * the stage of the Curse debuff on Gogh; e.g. Gogh has Stage 7 Curse, so NP Cooldown is reduced by 2◈+⅓◈ Turns). Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Insanity
system: (Passive) All damage dealt is increased by 6% including NP.

name: Shadow of Longing Falls Upon the Water in the Urn
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Used on an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of herself. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. 2. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 60%. Then, applies the following effects to Gogh- 1. Apply the 'Gogh' buff to herself for 1◈ Turns. 2. Remove all Curse debuffs from all Units within a 3 panel area of Gogh, then apply them to herself. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Sunflower's Curse
system: (Passive 1) Gogh cannot be ordered to commit suicide/kill herself, even with a Command Spell. (Passive 2) Gogh's Health cannot drop below 1 due to the effects of Curse (Gogh cannot be defeated due to the effects of Curse).

name: Het Gele Huis: The Yellow House
system: (Non-damaging) Used during your Turn. Affects all enemy Units within a 7x7 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gogh. Has the following effects- 1. Has a 150% chance of inflicting Def Dwn for 2◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%. 2. Inflicts Def Dwn (C) for 2◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%, and Agility is reduced by 1 whenever this Unit is successfully Attacked. Then, applies the following effects to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself- 1. Applies Evade for 2◈ Turns, 2 times. 2. Applies Regen for 3◈ Turns, Health is restored by 5% of its maximum value at the end of the Unit's Turn, at the end of a Turn the Unit Acts, and at the end of the Round. 3. Has a 500% chance of inflicting Curse twice on all affected allied Units. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if 'Het Gele Huis' is on Cooldown.

name: Golden Rule
system: (Passive) Whenever this Unit performs a Crit, it has a chance of reducing its NP Cooldown by 1 Turn.

name: Anti-Spirit Combat
system: (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Spirit' or 'Undead' Attribute is increased by 40% including NP. Gain 1 additional Mythos Counter for every Unit with those Attributes hit by a successful Attack. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Grave) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Spirit' or 'Undead' Attribute is (further) increased by 60%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns

name: Blessings from the End of the World
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Reduce Gray's NP Cooldown by ½◈ Turns. 2. Applies Debuff ResUp for 1◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 30%. 3. Gain 4 Mythos Counters. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Face of the King
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Gray hides her face with her hoodie. Applies the 'Hoodie' effect for 2◈ Turns. The 'Hoodie' effect has the same effects as 'Presence Concealment — Rank: E'. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns after the 'Hoodie' effect is removed from Gray. (Presence Concealment — Rank: E) 1. This Unit cannot be targeted for an Attack or an enemy Unit's Skill. If it is caught in an AoE Attack and fails to Evade, Flip a Coin. If Heads, no damage and effects are received; if Tails, Total Damage taken from that Attack is reduced by 50% & PC is deactivated. 2. This Unit's Attacks cannot be Blocked or Countered unless the DU's current Agility is equal to or higher than it. If the DU Evades, the Evade Roll is increased by 2. 3. This Unit is able to Attack Masters and Move to any panel regardless of enemy Master-Servant positions. 4. All damage dealt is increased by 100% (doubled); if NP, 50%. Does not apply against Masters. 5. After performing an Attack while PC is Active, PC is deactivated at the end of the Combat Process. 6. When This Unit Moves into an enemy Servant's Range (or Detect, if in use), it has an 80% chance of being discovered. 7. Active Skills targeting/affecting an enemy Unit(s) cannot be used unless stated. Note: Does not include Attack Skills and Spells that deal damage. 8. The effects of Presence Concealment are neither a buff or a debuff, and are Unremovable. Note: This Skill is not affected by Skill Seal.

name: King's Reflection
system: (Passive 1) At the end of Gray's Turn and at the end of any Turns she Acts, her NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns instead of 1 Turn. (Passive 2) Upon performing a successful Normal Attack, gain 1 Mythos Counter (2 if Crit). The maximum number of Mythos Counters is 40.

name: Rhongomyniad Mythos: Tower of Dreams Founding the Ends of the World
system: (Non-damaging) Used during your Turn. Can only be used when Gray has 40 Mythos Tokens. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit within Range. If this NP is not successfully Evaded, the DU is inflicted with the 'Mythos' debuff; this debuff ignores Debuff Resist & Immune effects. Its effects are as follows- 1. Attacks which use Base Attack (MAG) or deal MAG damage cannot be used. If an Attack were to use Base Attack (STR) & Base Attack (MAG) combined, damage calculation is performed only with Base Attack (STR). 2. Spells & NP cannot be used and their Passive effects are negated. The exceptions to this effect are [Anti-Unit Mystic Sword] & [Anti-Unit Secret Technique] NPs. 3. The effects of Divinity are negated. 4. This debuff is Unremovable except by an effect from a Rank EX Skill or NP. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: Rhongomyniad: The Spear That Shines To The Ends Of The World
system: Can only be used while Gray has the 'Logos' effect. Applies Pierce for ⅓◈ Turns to herself. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 1x6 or 6x1 panel area in any direction next to Gray (if diagonal, 1x5 or 5x1). Damage dealt depends on how many of the following criteria are met- 1. At least two DUs have at least 3 Parameters respectively that are equal to or higher than Gray's. 2. There is only one DU in the NP area. 3. At least two DUs have the 'Evil' Alignment. 4. Gray's Health is less than at least two of the DUs. 5. None of the DUs have at least 3 Parameters respectively that are two Ranks below Gray's. 6. None of the DUs have the 'Elemental' Attribute. If none of the criteria are met, Rhongomyniad deals 3x damage plus 100. For every criteria that is met, damage dealt is increased by 0.2x (e.g. 4 criteria met, damage=3.8x). Note: Criteria 1, 3, 4, and 5 are also accounted for when Criteria 2 is fulfilled, in this case the single DU needs to meet the conditions of the Criteria for them to be fulfilled. When Rhongomyniad is used and none of the criteria are met, Gray's Master loses 30 Health as the cost for this NP. For every criteria that is met, his Master loses an additional 10 Health. Then, all affected enemy Units are inflicted with NP Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all NP damage received is increased by 30%; and inflicted with Def Dwn (C) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 20%, and Agility is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. Then, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn for each Criteria that is met and gain 2 Mythos Counters for every Unit hit by this NP. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns if no criteria are met, increases by ½◈ Turns for every criteria that is met. Note: If Gray is summoned in a Grand Order Holy Grail War on the Chaldea Faction, the multiplier of Rhongomyniad begins at 4x instead of 3x.

name: Sealing Mystic Code Release
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 4 Agility. 2. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 30%. 3. Applies Invuln for ⅓◈ Turns, 1 time. 4. Applies the 'Logos' effect for 2◈ Turns. This effect is neither a buff or debuff and is Unremovable. After the 'Logos' effect naturally expires, it cannot be re-applied to Gray for the next 2◈ Turns. If Gray had 30 Mythos Counters or more when the 'Logos' effect is applied, it no longer has a duration. 5. Gain 1d6 Mythos Counters. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns

name: Chibirā Sanu・Habetrot: The Lion's Gallant Figure that Stirs the Seas
system: Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range+2 for the Combat Process. First, has the following effects- 1. Applies NP DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns, NP Damage dealt is increased by 10% for every enemy Unit within a 3 panel area of herself. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by (X+1)0%; if NP, X0%; X=the number of allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself. Next, Habetrot transforms into Shisarot Form for 3◈ Turns (if used while in Shisarot Form, its duration is extended). Hits a 2x2 panel area within Range for 5x damage, damage dealt to Units with the 'Large' Attribute is further increased by 150%. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns. (Passive) Habetrot gains the following effects while in Shisarot Form- 1. Size is increased from 1 panel to 2 panels. 2. Gains the 'Large' Attribute. 3. Max and current Health are increased by 100% of their original values. 4. The effects of some Skills are upgraded to the values in this colour. 5. The effects of Active Skills which are applied to all allied Units within the specified area now affect Habetrot herself only. 6. The amount of damage taken that is required to trigger an Agility Roll is doubled (i.e. 200). 7. Habetrot cannot Block; and when she performs an Agility Check, double the value of the roll. 8. Habetrot can Move to any panel, when she Moves to any occupied panels, all Units occupying said panels are knocked back by 1 panel until the space is free for Habetrot to stand on. 9. Normal Attacks at a Range of 1 use Base Attack (STR). Normal Attacks at a Range of 2 or higher use Base Attack (MAG). Normal Attacks now hit a 2x2 panel area, and knocks back the DU(s) by one panel. 10. Whenever Habetrot transforms into Shisarot Form, apply a 'Pretender (>X)' effect to her, this 'Pretender (>X)' effect lasts until she exits Shisarot Form. 11. When Shisarot Form is about to end at the end of a Turn, her Master can spend one Command Spell to extend its duration by 3◈ Turns. If extended in this way, Habetrot's Skill Cooldown is reduced by 1◈ Turns and Habetrot's next Attack deals 100% extra damage; if NP, 50%.

name: Divine Beast's Rage
system: Only in effect when in Shisarot Form. (Passive 1) Whenever Shisarot uses a non-Attack Skill, gain 1 Shiisaa Counter. (Passive 2) When Shisarot has 3 Shiisaa Counters, immediately remove all of them and apply the following effects to herself- 1. Applies NP DmUp for 1 time, NP Damage dealt is increased by 15%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Kaiju) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Large' Attribute is increased by 30%; if the DU also has the 'Giant' Attribute, all damage dealt is further increased by 30%. 3. Applies E.Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, non-NP AoE damage dealt is increased by 30%. 4. Skill Cooldown is reduced by 1◈ Turns, and Cooldown of 'Great Decisive Battle at the Southern Sea' is reduced by an additional 1◈ Turns.

name: Glam Sight: Fairy Eyes
system: (Passive) When Habetrot is Attacked, Crit Chance of the AU is reduced by 5%.

name: Great Decisive Battle at the Southern Sea
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 3 Agility. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 3. For every 5% of Crit Chance on Habetrot above 50%, apply Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 5%, does not affect NP (max 10 stacks). (e.g. Crit Chance is 65%, 65%-50%=15%, Atk Up is applied 3 times.) 4. Applies NP DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns, NP Damage dealt is increased by 10% for every 300 Max Health on Shisarot. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Great Tropical Fireball
system: Attack Skill. Can only be used when in Shisarot Form. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range+1 for the Combat Process. Hits a 4x4 panel area within Range for 50% extra damage and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Guardian Faerie
system: (Passive) Affects both her Master and the allied Unit which is nearest to her (other than her Master); must be within a 2 panel area of Habetrot to gain these effects- 1. All damage taken is reduced by 10% including NP. 2. When this Unit is Attacked, if the AU has effects which increase damage dealt to Units with a specific Skill or Servant Class (and the DU has the applicable Skill or Servant Class), those effects are negated for this Unit only. (e.g. deals extra damage to Units with 'Existence outside the Domain'.)

name: Ocean Stirring Lion's Roar
system: Only in effect when in Shisarot Form. (Passive) At the start of Habetrot's Turn, if her NP is not on Cooldown, this Skill is automatically activated. Has the following effects- 1. NP Cooldown is Reset. 2. Applies Atk Up for 2◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 30%. 3. Applies Dmg Up (Large) for 2◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Large' Attribute is increased by 50%. 4. Applies S.Crit Up (Shiisa) for 2◈ Turns, 10 times (stacks); Crit Chance is increased by (5*X)%, X=the number of stacks are left for this buff. 5. The duration of Shisarot Form is extended by 1◈ Turns.

name: Sacred Guardian Beast
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Decoy for ⅓◈ Turns (1◈ Turns in Shisarot Form). 2. Applies Dmged NP Regen for ⅓◈ Turns (1◈ Turns in Shisarot Form), NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈ Turns when successfully hit by an Attack. 3. Applies Guts for 1◈ Turns, when defeated this Unit is revived with 30% of its Max Health. 4. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, Crit Chance is increased by 5% (herself only in Shisarot Form). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Shiisaa Beam
system: Attack Skill. Can only be used when in Shisarot Form. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 2x5 or 5x2 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to herself and inflicts Def Dwn (Total) for 1◈ Turns, Total damage taken is increased by 25% (does not stack). Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: A Strange Giant Shadow was Sighted on Majimun Island
system: (Passive) Habetrot has the following effects when not in Shisarot Form- 1. At a Range of 1, Normal Attacks use Base Attack (STR). At a Range of 2 or higher, Normal Attacks use Base Attack (MAG) and deal Water damage. 2. Evade rolls are reduced by 1d12. Does not affect non-Evade Agility Check rolls. 3. Habetrot's Master can spend one Command Spell to transform Habetrot into Shisarot Form for 3◈ Turns.

name: Swimsuit!
system: (Passive) All Total Water Damage received is reduced by 50% including NP.

name: Yanamun Reversal
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself (herself only in Shisarot Form). Has the following effects- 1. Applies Dmg Up (Demonic) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute is increased by 30%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Undead) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Undead' Attribute is increased by 30%. 3. Applies Volatile Debuff Immune for 1◈ Turns. 4. Applies Max HpUp for 1◈ Turns (2◈ Turns in Shisarot Form), Max & current Health is increased by 30% of its original value. 5. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 5%. The next two effects are applied to all enemy Units within a 3x3 (4x4 in Shisarot Form) panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to herself- 6. Inflicts Debuff ResDwn for 1◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted with debuffs is increased by 15%. 7. Inflicts Skill Seal for ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Battle Retreat
system: (Active) Used when Hassan is Attacked by an enemy Unit. The enemy Unit's Attack is canceled, Hassan is allowed to Move 7 panels, restore its Health by 40% of its maximum value, then remove all buffs from Hassan. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Expert of Many Specializations
system: (Passive 1) Whenever Hassan performs a dice roll outside of Combat, you can reduce or increase the value of that dice roll by up to 3. This effect cannot be used with the Active effect of this Skill. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Has a 70% chance of restoring 3 Agility, this effect is treated as 'applying a buff'. If successful, also apply AGL Up for 1◈ Turns, Agility Check rolls are reduced by 3. 2. Has a 70% chance of restoring 3 Luck, this effect is treated as 'applying a buff'. If successful, also apply LUC Up for 1◈ Turns, Luck Check rolls are reduced by 3. 3. Has a 70% chance of applying Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 4. Applies Dodge with a 70% chance of applying it for ⅔◈ Turns, otherwise it is only applied for ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. (Passive 2) When this Skill is used, apply its effects to all other Hundred-Faced Hassans within a 2 panel area of the user, but each Hassan has to perform their own respective rolls for applying the Skill's effects.

name: Librarian of Stored Knowledge
system: (Passive 1) Crit Chance is increased by 20%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈ Turns. 2. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 3. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 20%. 4. Applies Buff ChUp for 1◈ Turns, chance of applying buffs is increased by 20%. 5. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. (Passive 2) When this Skill is used, apply its Effects 3, 4, and 5 to up to two other Hundred-Faced Hassans within a 2 panel area of the user.

name: Zabaniya: Delusional Illusion
system: (Passive) Hassan's Master has a total of 100 Hassans. Hassan is only defeated when all 100 Hassans are defeated. At the start of the game, the Master can start with more than 1 Hassan in its Home Base. At the start of a Round, the Master can deploy additional Hassans onto its half of the field (or within a 2 panel area from the border of its Home Base). There can only be a maximum of ten Hundred-Faced Hassans on the field. Each Hassan is counted as a separate Unit, with its own Stats. Each Hassan will be coded with a number in ascending order when they are deployed. Skill & NP Cooldowns are shared between all Hassans except Presence Concealment & Battle Retreat. If more than one Hassan has a NP Regen buff, only the one with the strongest magnitude takes effect. When counting the number of Units who Move/Attack during your Turn, one Hundred-Faced Hassan counts as 0.5 of a Unit. The same Hassan can only Move/Attack once per Turn. (Active) [Anti-Army] Base Attack (STR) is used. Cannot be used if you have 10 or less Hassans remaining. Hits a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Hassan for 3.5x damage plus 200; then inflicts Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is decreased by 25%; and inflicts Def Dwn (A) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 20%, and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. Then, reduce the number of Hassans by 4d6. Cooldown: 6◈+⅔◈ Turns.

name: Bravery
system: Note: Bravery cannot be used and has no effects when Mad Enhancement is Active. (Passive) Chance of being inflicted with Mental Debuffs is reduced by 50%. (Active) Used during your Turn.
