Applies Atk Up (STR) for 1◈ Turns, STR damage dealt is increased by 25%; if NP, 15%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Eye of the Mind (False)
system: (Passive) Upon a successful Evade, reduce the Cooldown of this Skill by ⅓◈ Turns. (Active) Used at the start of a Combat Process when Attacked. Applies Dodge to Heracles for ⅔◈ Turns, and applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 35%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: God Hand: Twelve Labors
system: (Passive 1) Whenever Heracles' Health is reduced to 0, roll ten twenty-sided dice, and restore his Health by the number rolled. If the damage of the Attack that defeated Heracles exceeds his current Health, the excess damage is reduced from his newly restored Health, and so on. Can only be used 11 times. (Passive 2) Whenever an Attack reduces Heracles' Health to 0 for the first time, record that Attack under this Skill. These recorded Attacks can no longer defeat Heracles- whenever a recorded Attack would reduce his Health to 0, his Health will remain at 1 instead.

name: Indomitable
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies the 'Undying' buff for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns: when Heracles is defeated he is revived with 25% of his Max Health. This Undying buff stacks with other Guts buffs, but does not stack with itself. 2. Applies the 'Indomitable' buff to Heracles for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns. Its effects are as follows- whenever Heracles is defeated and revived through any effect, Atk Up is applied to him for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Nine Lives: Shooting the Hundred Heads
system: Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 4x damage plus 100. Then inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 30%.

name: Alice Eater
system: Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up to itself for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 25%; and extends its period of existing on the board for 3◈ more Turns. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Information Erasure
system: (Passive) Whenever Jack leaves the Detect area of an enemy Unit, erase all information recorded by that Player about Jack, if any had been recorded in the Player's Notebook (let the GM do this). (Active) Used during your Turn. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Removes all buffs on the Defending Unit; then inflicts Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Maria the Ripper: The Holy Mother of Dismemberment (Method 2)
system: Method 2. Requires: (i) the Round is a Night Round (automatically fulfilled if playing without Day-Night cycle); (ii) the target Unit is Female; (iii) both Jack and the target Unit are within the Mist. Base Attack (STR) is used. Range=4. If used at a Range of 1 or 2, this NP deals 3.5x damage plus 100; if the Defending Unit is Female, damage dealt is further increased by 100% (doubled). Then, has a 50% chance of inflicting Instakill. If used at a Range of 3 or 4, no damage is dealt, this NP just has a 50% chance of inflicting Instakill. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Maria the Ripper: The Holy Mother of Dismemberment
system: Method 1 (no conditions). Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 2.5x damage; if the Defending Unit is Female, damage dealt is further increased by 100% (doubled). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Murderer of the Misty Night
system: (Passive 1) Whenever Jack is Attacked by an enemy Unit, and the AU is within Jack's Range, Jack can Attack first instead of the opposing Unit. If it is a Day Round, the activation of this effect requires a Successful Luck Check. Luck Check is not required during Night Rounds. (Passive 2) Whenever Jack performs an Attack when both Jack and the DU are within 'The Mist'; increase the DU's Evade Roll by 4 if it Evades. (Active 1) Used during your Turn. Restore 3 Agility, applies Dodge to Jack for ⅓◈ Turns; and applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. If used while within the Mist, effect duration is increased to 1◈ Turns, and Atk Up boost is 50% instead of 30% (if NP, 30%). Cooldown: 3◈ Turns (4◈ Turns if used within the Mist).

name: Surgical Procedure
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Used on Jack or an allied Unit directly next to her. Restore the Unit's Health by 5% of its maximum value, and restores 1 Agility. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: The Mist: Darkened Misty Metropolis
system: (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, a cloud of Mist forms around Jack which covers a maximum of 25 panels. This area can be in any shape, but cannot expand past a distance of 4 panels from Jack (including diagonal). The effects of this Mist are as follows- 1. Normal Humans immediately die if they are caught in the Mist (this counts as Jack killing the Human). 2. Enemy Masters and non-normal Humans are inflicted with Poison upon contact with the Mist; and are inflicted with Poison at the end of its Turn or at the end of a Turn they Act while still within the Mist. (High Rank Masters are not inflicted with Poison upon contact.) 3. Whenever an enemy Servant within the Mist Rolls for Evade, increase the value rolled by 3. 4. The Move of all enemy Units within the Mist is halved. 5. The Detect of all enemy Units within the Mist is reduced to 1 panel. A Servant ignores effects 3, 4 and 5 if they have the Instinct Skill of Rank B or higher. Effect 4 is also ignored by any allied Units of that Servant with Instinct (Rank B or higher) who are standing directly next to them. 6. Jack's Master loses 15 Health at the end of the Turn after every 1◈ Turns since activation. Forcefully deactivated if her Master has 15 Health or less and would lose Health this way, at the end of a Turn Jack is defeated, or at any time Jack chooses. 7. Jack is not affected by the Fog of War area within the Mist. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns after The Mist is deactivated.

name: Carolus Patricius: Karl Cannons
system: Attack Skill. Range=5. Only usable when Carolus Patricius is Active. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 2x damage. Range is calculated from the edge of Carolus, along with the area directly under the Carolus. Categorized as Noble Phantasm. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Carolus Patricius
system: (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, place the 'Carolus Patricius' token on the board, with the middle panel being the panel Karl was standing on. The token has an area of 9x9 panels. All Units who were within a 9x9 panel area of Karl are moved onto the 'Patricius' token. Has the following effects- 1. The Carolus functions as a second Home Base for Karl's faction. 2. Karl's Master's ZON is ignored when he Attacks (no damage reduction) while within the Patricius. 3. In order to Escape the Carolus, enemy Servants have to Succeed a Luck Check against Karl (can be performed anywhere within the Carolus). If Successful, the Unit is Moved to the nearest panel immediately outside the Carolus. 4. Enemy Units can attempt to enter the Carolus. Either the Unit's STR or AGI Parameter has to be Rank A, and the nearest panel of the Carolus must be within the Unit's MOV minus 2 (when attempting to enter the Patricius, the Unit's MOV is reduced by 2). 5. All damage received by allied Units within the Patricius is reduced by 15% including NP. 6. Units within the Carolus cannot be targeted by Attacks from outside the Carolus and vice versa. However, the Patricius can be Attacked with an AoE Noble Phantasm. In this case, all Servants within the Carolus receive damage from the NP, but Total Damage received is reduced by 50%; while Masters are undamaged and unaffected by other effects. Note: If the NP used on the Carolus was an [Anti-Fortress] or higher Noble Phantasm, Carolus Patricius is forcefully ended at the end of the Combat Process. 7. All damage dealt by allied Units within the Carolus is increased by 15% except Noble Phantasms. 8. Units can Move under the Carolus (i.e. onto panels occupied by the Patricius, place the Carolus token on top of those Units). 9. Carolus Patricius initially lasts for 2◈ Turns. After the initial NP period, Karl can extend the duration of Carolus Patricius by 1◈ more Turns by reducing his Health by 200 (cannot be used if Karl's Health is less than 200), and can be repeatedly extended. 10. The Carolus is forcefully ended at the end of the Turn if Karl or his Master is defeated. Cannot be used if Carolus Patricius Auctoritas is on Cooldown. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns after the NP ends.

name: Ceremonial Reformation
system: (Passive) Affects all allied Units other than himself as long as he is on the board. Has the following effects- 1. All damage dealt is increased by 10% including NP. 2. All damage taken is reduced by 10% including NP. 3. Max Health is increased by 100. 4. Max Agility is increased by 1. 5. Max Luck is increased by 1. 6. At the end of every Turn an allied Unit Acts, its Health is restored by 5% of its maximum value. The magnitudes of Effects 1, 2, and 6 are doubled when the affected Unit is in its Home Base. (Ceremonial Reformation)

name: Carolus Patricius Auctoritas (Usage 2)
system: (Non-damaging) Used during your Turn. Karl summons the Carolus Patricius Auctoritas on the panel he was standing on, and he moves onto the top of it. Can be activated while Carolus Patricius is Active: if so, all Units on the Carolus Patricius excluding his Master are scattered below the Carolus, while his Master is placed together with Karl. At the end of every Turn this NP is Active, Karl's Master loses 30 Health if the CPA Acted, 10 if it did not (instead of the normal NP cost). If the Master's Health is equal to or less than that, the NP is forcibly ended at the end of the Turn and the Master loses nothing. Cooldown: 7◈+⅔◈ Turns after it ends.

name: Carolus Patricius Auctoritas: Sanctus (Usage 1)
system: Range=7. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Range. First deals 2x damage plus 100 using Base Attack (STR); then deals 2x damage plus 100 using Base Attack (MAG). Both hits of this NP can be separately Blocked and/or Evaded. Cannot be used if Carolus Patricius is Active. Cooldown: 7◈+⅔◈ Turns. While Usage 2 is Active: the Range is calculated from the edge of the CPA and the CPA's Base Attack is used; his Master's Health loss is increased by 50% plus 30, and Usage 2 is forcibly ended at the end of the Turn.

name: Great Emperor Privilege
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores his Health by 30% of its maximum value. 2. 60% chance of applying Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 20%. 3. 60% chance of applying Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is reduced by 40%; if NP, 20%. 4. NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅔◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Holy King
system: (Passive) Has the following effects- 1. All damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute or Units with the 'Divine' Attribute but without the 'Christian' Attribute is increased by 25% including NP. 2. All damage received from Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute or Units with the 'Divine' Attribute but without the 'Christian' Attribute is reduced by 25% including NP. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Dmg Up (Holy) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to those Units is further increased by 50%; if NP, 25%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Holy) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken from those Units is further reduced by 50%; if NP, 25%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Joyeuse: Peerless Sword
system: (Passive) All Normal Attack damage dealt by Karl to Units with the 'Dark' or 'Demonic' Attributes is increased by 100.

name: Brahmastra Kundala: O' Brahma, Curse Me
system: Cannot be used if Mana Burst (Flames) or Vasavi Shakti is on Cooldown. Range=5. Base Attack (STR) and Base Attack (MAG) combined is used. Hits a 7x7 panel area within Range for 4x damage plus 100, and inflicts Burn for 3◈ Turns to all affected Units. Then, inflicts Def Dwn (B) on all affected Units for 1◈ Turns (all damage received is increased by 30%; if NP, 40%). Fire damage. Affected by Magic Resistance. Karna is not affected by this NP if he is within the NP area. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns, and Mana Burst (Flames) also enters Cooldown when this NP is used.

name: Brahmastra: O' Brahma, Cover the Earth
system: Range=4. Base Attack (MAG) is used. This NP has the Aim effect. Has two different effects, depending on the DU- 1. If all of the DU's Parameters are equal or lower than Karna's, this NP deals 4x damage plus 100. 2. If the DU has any Parameter that is higher than Karna's, this NP deals 2x damage plus 100. Note: Does not deal extra damage to Units with Divinity. "Real heroes kill with their eyes."

name: Discernment of the Poor
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Inflicts NP Seal for ⅓◈ Turns and inflicts Debuff ResDwn for ⅓◈ Turns (chance of being inflicted with debuffs is increased by 50%).

name: End of Charity
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies the 'Charity' buff for 1◈ Turns; as long as Karna has this buff, both effects of 'Uncrowned Arms Mastership' are Active. 2. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself (Crit Chance +40%). 3. Reduce the NP Cooldown of Brahmastra, or Vasavi Shakti, or Brahmastra Kundala by 1◈ Turns (your choice).

name: Fated Rivals of the Mahabharata
system: (Passive) If Arjuna is on the opposing Faction and within Range of Karna, they will only Attack each other. This effect can be negated for 1◈ Turns by spending a Command Spell, but it will only affect Karna.

name: Flash of the Sun God
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 3 Agility. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns (all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%). 3. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns (NP Damage dealt is increased by 20%). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Mana Burst (Flames).

name: Kavacha and Kundala: O' Sun, Become Armor
system: (Passive) All damage received by Karna is reduced by 90% including NP; this effect is ignored by Attacks which have the Pierce effect. While Kavacha and Kundala is in effect, Karna's Master loses 20 Health at the end of every Turn that Karna is involved in a Combat Phase; his Master's Health cannot drop below 1 in this way. The effect of Kavacha and Kundala is lost when Vasavi Shakti is used/Activated.

name: Mana Burst (Flames)
system: (Passive) Karna's Normal Attacks have a 25% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns on the DU. Karna is Immune to Burn. All Total Fire Damage taken is reduced by 50% including NP. (Active) This Skill is used when performing a Normal Attack. For that Combat Process, Karna's Base Attack used is his BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (e.g. BA=300). If the Attack is not Evaded, Burn is inflicted on the DU for 2◈ Turns. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Fire Damage (half). Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Flash of the Sun God.

name: Uncrowned Arms Mastership
system: (Passive) At the start of the game, choose either Effect 1 or 2; this Skill starts with that effect Active. The effects of this Skill are negated by Skill Seal. 1. Crit Chance is increased by 20%. 2. Crit Damage dealt is increased by 40%. (Active) Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase. Switch the effect of this Skill from 1 to 2, or 2 to 1. Can only be used once per Round.

name: Vasavi Shakti — Activate
system: (Activation) Permanently applies the five effects of Vasavi Shakti to Karna. Kavacha and Kundala's effect is permanently lost. Base Attack (STR) +25 and STR Rank B → A. Normal Attacks deal extra damage to Units with Divinity. Normal Attacks inflict Burn at 50% instead of 25%. Karna's Master loses 20 Health at the end of every Combat Process he is involved in. Activating is different from using Vasavi Shakti's Active effect, and does not cost Master Health.

name: Vasavi Shakti: O' Sun, Abide to Death
system: (Active) Can only be used if Vasavi Shakti has been Activated. Cannot be used if Brahmastra Kundala is on Cooldown. Range=3 to 4. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 5x damage and inflicts Burn for 4◈ Turns to all affected Units. Fire damage. This NP deals extra damage to DUs with 'Divinity' as follows- Divinity Rank B to EX: damage dealt is further increased by 200% (tripled). Divinity Rank E to C: damage dealt is further increased by 100% (doubled). 'Divine' Attribute, no Divinity: damage dealt is further increased by 150%. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: Airavata King Size: Colossal Silhouette Emerging From The Ocean of Life
system: Base Attack (STR) is used. First, apply NP DmUp to Kingprotea for this Turn, NP damage dealt is increased by X%, as follows- 1. If Kingprotea's size is 1x1 panels, no increase 2. If Kingprotea's size is 2x2 panels, X=10% 3. If Kingprotea's size is 3x3 panels, X=20% 4. If Kingprotea's size is 4x4 panels, X=30% Hits a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to herself for 2x damage. Then, apply Atk Up to Kingprotea for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Goddess's Divine Core
system: (Passive 1) All damage dealt is increased by 100 including NP. (Passive 2) Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is decreased by 30%. This Skill counts as 'Divinity'.

name: Earth Mother's Wail
system: Attack Skill. Range+2 for the Combat Process. Deals normal damage which uses Base Attack (MAG). Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Giant Monster of the Great River
system: (Passive) Whenever Kingprotea uses the Monstrous Strength Skill, apply NP DmUp (GAO) to herself X times, where X = the number of Proliferation Stocks she has.

name: Huge Scale
system: (Passive 1) With the 'Giant' Attribute, Kingprotea can Move to any panel regardless of whether it is occupied or not; if the panel(s) is(are) occupied, all Units occupying said panels will be knocked back by 1 panel until Kingprotea has space to stand on. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies the Endless Proliferation buff to herself for 3◈+⅓◈ Turns and reduces her NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns. At the end of the Turn after every ⅓◈ Turns, Kingprotea gains 1 Proliferation stock. For each stock, Max and current Health is increased by 20% of her original Max Health. For every 3 stocks her size grows by 1 panel; each growth gives Range +1 and MOV −1. Maximum 10 stocks; they are not lost when Endless Proliferation ends. (Passive 2) For every Proliferation stock, NP damage received is reduced by 10% (maximum 80%). (Passive 3) If Kingprotea has 1 Proliferation stock, the chance of buffs being removed from herself is reduced by 35%. For every additional stock, the magnitude is increased by 5%. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.

name: Infantile Regression
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Removes the Endless Proliferation buff and all Proliferation stocks from Kingprotea. Then, reduce Kingprotea's NP Cooldown by ⅓◈ Turns × the number of Proliferation stocks removed in this way. Ignores effects that prevent buffs from being removed. Then reduce the Cooldown of Kingprotea's Skills by 1◈ excluding this Skill. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Monstrous Strength
system: (Active) Used at the start of a Damage Step when performing an Attack. STR Damage dealt by that Attack is increased by 150%; if NP, 75%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Self-Suggestion
system: (Passive) Chance of being inflicted with nvDebuffs is reduced by 60%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Removes all debuffs from Kingprotea, then applies nvDebuff ResUp for 1◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted by non-volatile debuffs is further reduced by 60%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Territory Creation
system: (Passive 1) When this Unit is in its Home Base, all damage dealt by it is increased by 6d20 including NP. (Passive 2) While this Unit is on the field, all damage taken by allied Units who are in their Home Base is further reduced by (3d10+30) including NP. Note: If there are multiple allied Units with this Skill, only the Territory Creation with the highest Rank takes effect.

name: Affection of the Holy Grail
system: (Passive) Kiritsugu's Luck is increased from Rank E to Rank EX; the Luck Check rolls of all Units within a 2 panel area of Kiritsugu are increased by 4 except himself. If Kiritsugu is inflicted with Skill Seal, instead of reducing his Max Luck, all of his Luck Check rolls are increased by 20; and the original effect is negated. These effects only last for the duration of Skill Seal. (Active) Applies Pierce to himself for 1◈ Turns; applies Crit DmUp to himself for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 50%; and all Units within a 2 panel area of Kiritsugu except himself are inflicted with Debuff ResDwn for 1◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted with debuffs is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Chronos Rose: Pick Ye Rosebuds While Ye May
system: Time Alter. Range 3. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 3.5x damage plus 100 that has the Ignore Def effect, then inflicts Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 30%, and increases the Defending Unit's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Thaumaturgy: Familiars
system: Spell. Used during your Turn. Applies the Range Up buff for 1◈ Turns, Range is increased by 2 panels; and applies Crit Up (Familiar) for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance for Attacks at a Range of 3 or higher is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Lethal Gunfire Suppression
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Restore 4 Luck; apply Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%, if NP 30%; and apply the Suppression buff for 1◈ Turns, 5 times. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Magecraft
system: (Passive 1) Allows the use of Thaumaturgy. Only one Thaumaturgy Spell can be used per Turn. (Passive 2) Whenever a Thaumaturgy Spell is used, extend the duration of the Suppression buff by 1◈ Turns.

name: Phantasm Punishment: Mystery Bisection
system: Range 1. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 3x damage plus 100 with a 35% chance of inflicting Instakill if damage was dealt. Then, applies the Kiritsugu debuff to the Defending Unit: the Unit's Base Attack (both STR and MAG) are reduced by half of their original value; this effect ignores Debuff Resist and Debuff Immune effects, and the debuff is Unremovable. It does not stack. Cooldown: 5◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Thaumaturgy: Penetration
system: Spell. Used during your Turn. Applies the Penetration buff to Kiritsugu for ⅓◈ Turns, its effects are as follows: when Kiritsugu deals damage with an Attack, it has the Ignore Def effect and halves the effect of Invuln. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Thaumaturgy: Reinforcement
system: Spell. Used at the start of a Combat Phase. During this Combat Phase, Normal Attack damage dealt is increased by 40%. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Scapegoat
system: (Active) Used during your Turn or when an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of Kiritsugu is Attacked. Used on an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of Kiritsugu. Applies Decoy (Scapegoat) to that Unit for 1◈ Turns, then applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Kiritsugu or the target, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Lethal Gunfire Suppression: Return Fire
system: (Passive) Whenever a Unit inflicted with Decoy (Scapegoat) is Attacked, if that Attacking Unit is within Kiritsugu's Range, Kiritsugu can instantly perform a Normal Attack on it which cannot be Reacted to unless that Unit's AGI Rank is higher than Kiritsugu's. Additionally, Kiritsugu can use a Thaumaturgy Spell once before performing this Normal Attack; it does not count towards his one Thaumaturgy Spell per Turn, but it will still enter Cooldown.

name: Blessings from the Ends of the World
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Reduces NP Cooldown by 2◈ Turns and removes all debuffs from herself. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Invisible Air: Bounded Field of the Wind King
system: Usage 1. Used together with Mana Burst, when used in this way, applies AGL Up for 1◈ Turns, Agility Check rolls are reduced by 3; and applies MOV Up for 1◈ Turns, MOV is increased by 3. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns. Does not reduce her Master's Health as a cost when used in this way. Note: Usage 1 cannot be used on the same Round as Usage 2 (Strike Air) and vice versa; but Usage 1 can be used while Usage 2 is on Cooldown and vice versa.

name: Mana Burst
system: (Active) This Skill is used when Arturia performs a Normal Attack. For that Combat Phase, Arturia's Base Attack used is her BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (BA=325). Not affected by Magic Resistance. Can be used while on Cooldown, but she has to be within her Master's ZON and her Master loses 20 Health; does not reset Cooldown. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Round as Torrent of Light.

name: Rhongomyniad: The Lance That Shines To The Ends Of The Earth
system: Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range=5 panels. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Range. This NP has the Pierce effect. Damage dealt depends on how many of the following criteria are met- 1. At least two DUs have at least 3 Parameters respectively that are equal to or higher than Arturia's. 2. There is only one DU in the NP area. 3. At least two DUs have the 'Evil' Alignment. 4. Arturia's Health is less than at least two of the DUs. 5. None of the DUs have at least 3 Parameters respectively that are two Ranks below Arturia's. 6. None of the DUs have the 'Elemental' Attribute. If none of the criteria are met, Rhongomyniad deals 3x damage plus 200. For every criteria that is met, damage dealt is increased by 0.5x. Light damage. Criteria 1, 3, 4, and 5 are also accounted for when Criteria 2 is fulfilled; the single DU needs to meet them. When Rhongomyniad is used and none of the criteria are met, Arturia's Master loses 30 Health as the cost for this NP. For every criteria that is met, her Master loses an additional 10 Health. Then, Rhongomyniad's Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns for each criteria that is met. Cooldown: 7◈+⅔◈ Turns. Note: in a Grand Order Holy Grail War on the Chaldea Faction the multiplier begins at 4x.

name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King
system: Usage 2 of Invisible Air. Hits a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Arturia. Deals 300 damage divided by the number of affected Units, to each affected Unit. Not affected by any damage modifying effects on Arturia. Wind damage. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Round as Usage 1 (Invisible Air) and vice versa.

name: Torrent of Light
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Chaotic) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Chaotic' Alignment is increased by 50%. 3. Applies Dmg Up (Evil) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Evil' Alignment is increased by 50%. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Round as Mana Burst.

name: Wild Hunt
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 2. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP Damage dealt is increased by 20%. 3. Applies NP DmUp (Round) for 1 time to all affected Units with the 'Round Table' Attribute, NP Damage dealt is increased by 30%. Does not stack. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. This Skill is categorized as 'Charisma'.

name: Fragarach Counter
system: The automatic Counter the Fragarach status performs. Deals 2.5x damage using Base Attack (STR), cannot be Blocked, and cannot be Evaded except with Dodge. Deals NP Damage, and is not affected by NP Seal.

name: Fragarach Enbarr: Wildly Running Sword of the War God
system: (Non-damaging) Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 5% for each Fragarach Token on herself; the magnitude of which is halved for NP. 2. Applies Decoy for ⅓◈ Turns. 3. Applies the Fragarach effect for ⅓◈ Turns to herself. The 'Fragarach' effect is neither a buff or a debuff and is Unremovable. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: Fragarach: Gouging Sword of the War God
system: Can only be used by removing 5 Fragarach Tokens from herself. Can be used when a Noble Phantasm is used against Mannanán. Cannot be used against (Passive) or (Non-damaging) Noble Phantasms. Has different effects depending on the NP used against her- 1. If the NP was the enemy Unit's strongest NP (or its only damage-dealing NP), the NP is canceled and the Servant/Unit who used the NP is inflicted with Instakill. 2. If the Noble Phantasm was not the enemy Unit's strongest, the Noble Phantasm is canceled and the equivalent amount of damage that NP would have dealt is dealt to the NP's user instead (only affects the user if it was an AoE NP). Both versions of this NP are effective at any Range. Fragarach cannot be responded to (Block, Evade, Luck Check, Counter, etc). Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: God's Holder: Possession
system: (Active) Can only be used when Mannanán's Health is less than 30% of its maximum value OR when she is defeated, and while she has at least 1 Fragarach Token. Remove all Fragarach Tokens from Mannanán and she enters Holder Mode, restoring her Health to 50% of its maximum value. (Passive) While Mannanán is in Holder Mode- 1. The maximum number of Fragarach Tokens is increased to 7. 2. Mannanán now also gains 1 Fragarach Token at the end of every Turn she Acts. 3. Range is increased to 3 panels. 4. Normal Attacks at a Range of 1 to 2 use Base Attack (STR) and 30% of Base Attack (MAG) combined (e.g. 150+75=225), not affected by Magic Resistance. Normal Attacks at a Range of 3 or higher use Base Attack (MAG). 5. Toole Fragarach is replaced with Hallowed Sea God's Sword.

name: Hallowed Sea God's Sword
system: Attack Skill. Range+1 for the Combat Process. Uses Base Attack (STR) and 50% of Base Attack (MAG) combined (e.g. 150+125=275). Deals 30% extra damage; if the DU Evades, its Evade Roll is increased by 3. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Sea God's Rune
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. NP Cooldown is reduced by 2◈ Turns. 2. Applies Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 30%. 3. Applies Crit DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 100%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Sealing Designation Enforcer
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restore 3 Agility. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 3. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. 4. Applies Atk Up (Magus) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Magus' Attribute is increased by 30% including NP. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Note: Units with the 'Magus' Attribute — Masters, Casters, all Units whose Normal Attacks use Base Attack (MAG).

name: Successor of the Red Branch
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Evade for ⅓◈ Turns. 2. Applies Debuff Immune for ⅓◈ Turns. 3. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, Crit Chance is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Toole Fragarach: Gouging Greatsword of the War God
system: Attack Skill. Can only be used by removing 3 Fragarach Tokens from herself. Range+2 for the Combat Process. Deals normal damage three times; if the DU Evades, its Evade Roll is increased by 3 and if any Evade fails, the remaining hits cannot be Evaded; if the DU Blocks, damage is reduced from the Total Damage taken. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: God's Holder: Tradition Carrier
system: (Passive 1) The maximum number of Fragarach Tokens Mannanán can have is 5. Mannanán gains a Fragarach Token at the end of every Round. (Passive 2) At the start of a Combat Phase, Mannanán can remove 1 Fragarach Token from herself, her Crit Chance is increased by 30% for that Combat Phase. (Passive 3) Crit Damage dealt is increased by 5% for every Fragarach Token on Mannanán. (Passive 4) The duration of buffs are extended by ⅓◈ extra Turns when applied to Mannanán.

name: Αερο (Aero)
system: Damage Spell. Deals 2x damage and inflicts Bleed for 1◈ Turns. Wind damage.

name: Μαρδοξ (Argos)
system: Spell. Used during your Turn or when Attacked. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns: all damage taken is reduced by 50%; if NP, 30%.

name: Ατλας (Atlas)
system: Spell. Used during your Turn. Inflicts Stun on an enemy Unit within Range for 1◈ Turns. The chance is reduced by 25% against a Unit with MAG Rank B or higher, and by 25% against a Unit with Magic Resistance Rank B or higher. These reductions DO stack.

name: Dragon Tooth Warriors
system: Spell. Roll 1d6 for the number of Dragon Tooth Warriors conjured, placed within a 5x5 panel area around Medea. Roll 1d4 for each to decide its type. They do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn, and each may Move/Attack only once per Turn. Enemy Units cannot Attack Medea or her Master while any Dragon Tooth Warrior is directly next to them.

name: Golden Fleece
system: (Active) Recovers Health by Loving the Skin. Restores Medea's Health by 30% of its maximum value, and restores 3 Agility.

name: High-Speed Divine Words
system: (Active) Completely reduce the cooldown of all of Medea's Spells. Cannot be used, and its effects are negated, while inflicted with Silence.

name: Item Construction
system: (Passive) Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area. The chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by 50% (Instakill 25%, Death 10%); the chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 50% (Instakill 25%, Death 10%).

name: Κεραινο (Keraino)
system: Spell. Used during your Turn. Applies MOV Up for 1◈ Turns: MOV is increased by 3. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Tροψα.

name: Rain of Light: Machia Hecatia Graea
system: Damage Spell. Range +1 for the Combat Process. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 3x damage.

name: σπάσιμο κανόνα (Rule Breaker): Destroyer of All Talismans
system: Range 1. Uses Base Attack (STR). Deals 1x damage plus 100 and removes all buffs from the Defending Unit. If the DU is a Servant and it Failed to Evade the NP, Rule Breaker cuts the Servant's Contract with its Master and removes that Master's Command Spells; the Contract, along with three Command Spells, is given to Medea.

name: Teachings of Circe
system: (Active) Used on an allied Unit within Range 3. Remove all debuffs from it, restore its Health by 10% of its maximum value, and apply NP Cooldown Regen for 1◈ Turns.

name: Tροψα (Trofa)
system: Spell. Used when Attacked. Automatically Evades the Attack. If the Attack was a Noble Phantasm, Medea has a 50% chance of automatically Evading it; if it fails, the Combat Process proceeds as normal.

name: Bellerophon: Bridle of Chivalry - Pegasus
system: Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 1x13 or 13x1 panel area in a straight line in any direction (including diagonal) next to Medusa for 4x damage plus 100. Then, applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 30%. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Blood Fort Andromeda: Outer-Seal, Blood Temple
system: (Passive) To use this Noble Phantasm, Medusa has to first Mark the four corner panels of a 5x5, 7x7, or 9x9 panel area; these Marks are Bloodmarks. The 'Mark' Action places a Bloodmark on the panel Medusa is standing on and counts as her Attack for the Turn. Bloodmarks can be placed on any panel, even within enemy Home Bases. If all four Bloodmarks are complete, Blood Fort Andromeda is activated. Only Masters can destroy a Bloodmark, by Attacking it; Bloodmarks can only be seen from a distance of 3 cells maximum. Once activated it is continuously Active until Medusa is defeated. It affects all Units within its area excluding Medusa and her Master: Normal Human: immediately dies; Medusa or her Master heals 100 Health and 1 Agility. Master, non-normal Human: loses 40 Health at the end of every Turn it Acts within the area. Servant, non-Human: loses 20 Health at the end of every Turn it Acts within the area. The total Health lost from all affected victims heals either or both Medusa and her Master, and cannot exceed the amount drained. The effects are halved against 'Mechanical' Units.

name: Blood Temple
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅔◈ Turns and apply NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. If Blood Fort Andromeda is Active, NP Cooldown is reduced by 2◈ Turns instead. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Monstrous Snake Metamorphosis
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up (STR) for 1◈ Turns, STR Damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. 2. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. 3. Applies Dmg Up (Bind) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units inflicted with Bind effects is increased by 50%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Monstrous Strength.

name: Monstrous Strength
system: (Active) Used at the start of a Damage Step when performing an Attack. STR Damage dealt by that Attack is increased by 80%; if NP, 40%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Monstrous Snake Metamorphosis.

name: Mystic Eyes of Petrification: Cybele
system: Used during your Turn. Range 2 panels, on an enemy Unit. Cannot be used if there is an obstruction between Medusa and the target, and only if Medusa is facing it. Humans (including Masters): Perform an Agility Check. If Successful, the DU is Stunned for 2◈ Turns. If Failed, the DU is Petrified. Non-humans, Servants with MAG of Rank C or lower: Perform an Agility Check. If Successful, reduce the DU's Agility by 2. If Failed, roll again. On the second time, if Successful, the DU is Stunned for 1◈ Turns. If Failed, the DU is Petrified. Servants with MAG of Rank B or higher: Perform an Agility Check. If Successful, reduce the DU's Agility by 2. If Failed, the DU is Stunned for 1◈ Turns. Debuffs inflicted by this Skill ignore the DU's debuff resistance due to Magic Resistance.

name: Mental Pollution
system: (Passive 1) Chance of inflicting debuffs is increased. (Passive 2) Chance of being inflicted by Mental Debuffs is reduced.

name: Barrel Bombing
system: Attack Skill. Hits a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Nemo for 150 Fire damage and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns. Damage of this Attack Skill is not affected by damaging modifying effects on Nemo. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Great Ram Nautilus: I Conquer, with Nautilus' Great Naval Ram
system: Range=7. Base Attack (STR) is used. When this NP is used, first apply the following effects to Nemo- 1. Applies NP DmUp for this Turn to Nemo, NP damage dealt is increased by 30%. 2. If Nemo is within a 'Waterside' or 'Imaginary Numbers Space' area, apply Aim to himself for this Turn. 3. If Nemo is within a 'Waterside' or 'Imaginary Numbers Space' area, apply NP DmUp to himself for this Turn, NP damage dealt is increased by 20%. Then, deals 4x damage. If the DU has the 'Large' Attribute, damage dealt is further increased by 150%. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns.

name: Indomitable
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. First reduce Nemo's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns, then apply Guts for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, when Nemo is defeated he is revived with 20% of his Max Health. Also applies the 'Indomited' buff 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, 1 time, when Nemo is revived due to Guts, reduce his NP Cooldown by 1◈+⅔◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Journey's Guidance
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself, or if Zero Sail is activated, affects all allied Units within the Storm Border. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 15%. 2. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 3. If Nemo is within a 'Waterside' or 'Imaginary Numbers Space' area, apply Effect 1 twice. Cooldown: 3◈-⅔◈ Turns.

name: Poseidon's Protection
system: (Passive) Has the following effects- 1. Crit Damage of Attacks which use Base Attack (MAG) is increased by 10%. Does not affect NP. 2. When Nemo is within a 'Waterside' or 'Imaginary Numbers Space' area, all damage taken is reduced by 50; if NP, 100.

name: Quickfire
system: Attack Skill. Range=3. Roll 6 six-sided die, this Attack Skill deals 25 STR damage for each die that rolls X or higher, where X=5. The value of X is modified as follows. Plus 1 if- 1. The enemy Unit Evades (instead of performing an Evade roll) Minus 1 if- 1. This Attack Skill is used at a Range of 2 or lower. 2. The enemy Unit is inflicted with Slow, Immobilize or Stun. 3. The enemy Unit's Agility is equal or lower than Nemo's. After performing this Attack Skill, if the enemy Unit does not perform a Counter on Nemo, reduce the Cooldown of Quickfire by 1◈ Turns. A DU damaged by this Attack Skill only performs an Injury Roll once, regardless of number of hits received. Damage of this Attack Skill is not affected by damaging modifying effects on Nemo. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Triton's Conch
system: Attack Skill. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 5x5 panel area around Nemo. Deals 1.5x damage to Units directly next to Nemo, while Units at a 2 panel distance receive 0.5x damage. Then, inflicts the 'Deafen' debuff to all affected Units for 1◈ Turn, all Evade rolls are increased by 2, MOV is reduced by 1, and Detect is reduced by 1 panel. If the Unit was 2 panels away from Nemo, the chance of being inflicted with Deafen is 50% instead. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Voyager of the Storm
system: (Passive) Sails on the Imaginary Numbers Submersible - Storm Border. (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself, or if Zero Sail is activated, affects all allied Units within the Storm Border. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 10%; if NP, 5%. 2. Applies NP DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 10%. 3. If Nemo is within a 'Waterside' or 'Imaginary Numbers Space' area, apply Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. Cooldown: 2◈-⅔◈ Turns; if Effect 3 is applied, 3◈-⅔◈ Turns.

name: Storm Border: Zero Sail
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. When this Skill is used, Nemo and any number of allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself enters the Storm Border and warps into the Imaginary Numbers Space. Enemy Units within a 3 panel area of Nemo when Zero Sail is activated can attempt to enter the Storm Border as well, roll a twenty-sided die; the enemy Unit only successfully enters if it rolls 18 or higher. While within the Storm Border, all Units still take their Turn normally. At the end of any Turn, Nemo can choose to resurface the Storm Border, which places all Units within the Storm Border onto a 5x5 panel area on the board excluding enemy Home Bases, in any orientation. The maximum distance at which Nemo can travel depends on how much time was spent in Imaginary Numbers Space. This distance is 2+X panels, where X=1 for every ⅓◈ Turns spent within Imaginary Numbers Space. The maximum time the Storm Border can spend within Imaginary Numbers Space is 2◈ Turns, Nemo is forced to resurface after 2◈ Turns have passed since using Zero Sail. If Nemo is defeated while Zero Sail is Active, he performs a Luck Check before dying. If successful, the Storm Border immediately resurfaces (but he is still defeated); if failed, all Units within the Storm Border are inflicted with Erase. Units within the Storm Border cannot use Skills, NP, or any other ability that creates a Unit/Item/object that has the 'Large' or 'Giant' Attribute. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns after Nemo resurfaces.

name: Magic Crest
system: (Active) Damage Spell. Deals 2x damage. Categorized as Noble Phantasm. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. Usable from Round 3 onward.

name: Nursery Rhyme: A Tale for Somebody's Sake
system: Range=4. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 3x damage. Then, inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%, and increases the NP Cooldown of all affected Units by 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns.

name: Frenzied March Hare
system: Damage Spell. Deals damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Sap for 1◈ Turns. Wind damage. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Nursery Rhyme: Jabberwock
system: (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, Nursery summons the Jabberwock on a panel next to her. It disappears after 3◈ Turns. When the Jabberwock is summoned for the first time, the [Vorpal Blade] Item appears on a random panel on the game board; it can be picked up by a Unit walking onto its panel. Summoning it counts as Nursery's Attack for the Turn. When the Jabberwock is summoned again after disappearing, its Stats will be the same as when it disappeared. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns after the Jabberwock disappears.

name: Meanwhile…
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Reduces NP Cooldown by 1◈+⅓◈ Turns. 2. Restores Nursery's Health by 15% of its maximum value. 3. Remove all debuffs from Nursery. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Nursery Rhyme: Nameless Forest
system: (Passive) At the end of every Round, this NP affects all enemy Units within a 2 panel area of Nursery. Each time a Unit is affected, it gains one Nameless Forest Token; this does not occur if Nursery is inflicted with NP Seal. For every Token on a Unit, reduce its Max Health by 25, Base Attack (both) by 10, and Max Luck by 1.

name: Plains of Winter
system: Damage Spell. Deals damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Disable for 1◈ Turns. Ice damage. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: The Queen's Glass Game: Perpetual Engine - Maiden Empire
system: (Passive) Has two different effects, as follows- 1. Activates at the end of the Turn, 3◈ Turns after Nursery enters Combat, if there are still enemy Units within a 3 panel area of Nursery at the end of that Turn; the Stats, Parameters, Buffs, Debuffs, Cooldowns and other existing effects of all Units within a 3 panel area of Nursery are returned to what they were 3◈ Turns ago. Does not affect Nameless Forest Tokens. At the end of every Round, if there are no enemy Units within a 3 panel area of Nursery, the duration of time passed for this NP is reset. 2. Activates when Nursery is defeated. The same are returned to what they were 6◈ Turns before Nursery was defeated (includes herself). Does not affect Nameless Forest Tokens. Can only be used once during the entire game.

name: Self-Modification
system: (Passive) Crit Damage dealt is increased by 40%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 60%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Shapeshift
system: (Passive) All damage taken is reduced by 30%; if NP, 15%.

name: Tommy Thumb's Secret Picture Book
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 3 Luck and applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. 2. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is reduced by 30%; if NP, 15%. 3. Applies Dmg Cut for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage taken is reduced by 30 including NP. 4. Applies Debuff ResUp for 1◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted with debuffs is reduced by 40%. 5. Reduce the NP Cooldown of all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself with the 'Child' Attribute by ⅔◈ Turns. 6. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself with the 'Fairytale' Attribute, NP Damage dealt is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Nursery Rhyme: Trump Soldiers
system: (Non-damaging) Used during your Turn. Roll an eight-sided die and add 4 to that number, Nursery summons that number of Trump Soldiers within a 2 panel area of herself. They do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn, and the same Trump Soldier can only Move/Attack once per Turn. Enemy Units cannot Attack Nursery or her Master if any Trump Soldiers are directly next to them. Counts as Nursery's Attack for the Turn. Cooldown: ⅓◈ Turns for each Trump Soldier summoned.

name: White Queen's Enigma
system: Spell. Used during your Turn. Applies the 'Enigma' buff to Nursery for 1◈ Turns. Its effects are as follows- Whenever Alice performs a Normal Attack which deals STR damage, Nursery inflicts the Def Dwn (MAG) debuff for 1◈ Turns on the DU, all MAG damage taken is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Defender of Humanity (Normal Attack)
system: A Normal Attack made in Defender of Humanity's method. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range. Total damage dealt is reduced by 10% for every Unit within the Attack area. This Normal Attack is not affected by effects which increase or decrease Crit Damage dealt. Can only be used once per Turn.

name: Defender of Humanity
system: (Passive 1) When Olga Marie is defeated by a Unit with the 'Threat to Humanity' Attribute, she revives with her Health, Agility, and Luck restored to 50% of their maximum values. Can only activate once per game. (Passive 2) Normal Attacks can be used in this method- Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range. Total damage dealt is reduced by 10% for every Unit within the Attack area. This Normal Attack is not affected by effects which increase or decrease Crit Damage dealt. Can only be used once per Turn.

name: Earth-Shattering
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. NP Cooldown is fully reduced. 2. Applies Overcharge for 1◈ Turns, 1 time, the magnitude of all non-damage effects of NP is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Flawlessness
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Can only be used when NP is not on Cooldown. Has the following effects- 1. NP Cooldown is Reset. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Standard) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Standard-class Servants is increased by 50%. 3. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. The following effects affect all allied Units within a 3 panel area of herself- 4. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 5. Applies E.Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all non-NP AoE damage dealt is increased by 100%. 6. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. 7. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 8. Applies Pierce for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Four Elements・The Great Enemy: The Yet Existing Four Gods
system: (Passive) Can be used when performing a Normal Attack at Range of 2 or higher. When used, roll a six-sided die and activate the corresponding effect- 1. Nothing happens, Combat proceeds as normal. 2. The Attack deals Fire damage and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns. 3. The Attack deals Water damage and inflicts Soaked for 2◈ Turns. 4. The Attack deals Lightning damage and inflicts Shock for 2◈ Turns. 5. U-Olga Marie first performs an Attack using Base Attack (STR), then immediately performs an extra follow-up Attack using Base Attack (MAG). If the DU Blocked the first hit, it must also Block the second hit; if the DU failed to Evade the first hit, it cannot React to the second hit. 6. Your choice. Effects 2, 3, 4, and 5 can only activate once per Turn; if one of those effects that has already been activated this Turn is rolled, the roll is treated as 'Nothing happens'. 'Four Elements' has no effect while inflicted with NP Seal.

name: Gravity Manipulation
system: (Passive) Has the following effects- 1. MOV is increased by 1 and Olga Marie gains the 'Levitating' Attribute. 2. The MOV of all enemy Units 3 panels away from her is reduced by 3 and Agility Check rolls are increased by 3. If they are 2 panels away from her, MOV is reduced by 4 & Agility Check rolls are increased by 4. If they are directly next to her, MOV is reduced by 5 & Agility Check rolls are increased by 5. Minimum value of MOV is 1 when reduced in this way. 3. Ranged Attacks which deal STR damage from 4 or more panels away from Olga Marie have no effect on her. The effects of this Skill are negated while inflicted with Skill Seal.

name: Gyakkou
system: Backlight. (Passive) Whenever Olga Marie is defeated and revived through an effect, apply the following effects to herself- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. 2. Applies Invuln (Gyakkou) for 1◈ Turns, 1 time. Invuln (Gyakkou) is separate from normal Invuln, and is consumed first when Attacked. 3. NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns. 4. Max Health is reduced by 10% of its maximum value. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Planet Olga Marie: The Already Passed End of the Human Order
system: Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 9x9 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to herself. First, has the following effects- 1. Inflicts Agility Loss for 1◈ Turns, if this debuff fails to be inflicted, the DU loses 2 Agility. 2. Inflicts Luck Loss for 1◈ Turns, if this debuff fails to be inflicted, the DU loses 2 Luck. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn (B) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%; if NP, 30%. Deals 5x damage, damage dealt is further increased by 200% against Units with the [Man], [Star], or 'Living Human' Attributes. Then, has the following effects on all allied Units within a 3 panel area of herself- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 2. NP Cooldown is reduced by ½◈ Turns. 3. NP Cooldown of affected Units with the [Man], [Star], or 'Living Human' Attributes is reduced by ½◈ Turns. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns

name: Unparalleled
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Skill Cooldown is reduced by 2◈ Turns. 2. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP Damage dealt is increased by 30%. 3. Applies the 'Unparalleled' effect for this Turn, this is neither a buff or debuff and is Unremovable. Its effects are as follows- This Turn, no other allied Servants can Attack other than U-Olga Marie, and U-Olga Marie can Attack up to three times this Turn. This effect is not applied if any other allied Servant has already Attacked this Turn. 4. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 3 panel area of herself, Crit Chance is increased by 50%. 5. Inflicts NP Seal for ⅓◈ Turns to all enemy Units within a 3 panel area of herself. 6. Inflicts Heal Dwn for 1◈ Turns to all enemy Units within a 3 panel area of herself, when Health is restored, the amount restored is reduced by 50%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Ramesseum Tentyris: Dendera Electric Bulb (Area)
system: Method 2 of the Dendera Electric Bulb. Hits a 2x2 panel area within Range for 1.5x damage, using Base Attack (MAG). Range is any panel within the Complex, and 4 panels beyond its border (3 if diagonal). Damage dealt is not affected by Atk Up or other damage increasing effects on Ozymandias. His Master loses 10 Health per use.

name: Ramesseum Tentyris: Dendera Electric Bulb
system: Ozymandias' Normal Attack while within Ramesseum Tentyris. Hits 1 Unit within Range for 2x damage, using Base Attack (MAG). Range is any panel within the Complex, and 4 panels beyond its border (3 if diagonal). Damage dealt is not affected by Atk Up or other damage increasing effects on Ozymandias. His Master loses 10 Health per use.

name: Imperial Privilege
system: (Active) Restores his Health by 30% of its maximum value. 60% chance of Atk Up for 1◈ Turns: all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 20%. 60% chance of Def Up for 1◈ Turns: all damage received is reduced by 40%; if NP, 20%.

name: Mesektet: The Solar Ship of the Dark Night
system: (Passive) The source of Ozymandias' Normal Attacks. All Normal Attacks use Base Attack (MAG) and deal extra damage to Units with the 'Dark' Attribute — damage dealt is increased by 100%. Light damage. (Active) Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 4x damage plus 100; deals extra damage to Units with the 'Dark' Attribute, damage dealt is increased by 100% (doubled). Light damage.

name: Pharaoh of the Hot Sands
system: (Active) Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself. 1. Atk Up for 1◈ Turns: all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 2. If used during a Day Round, Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns: Crit Chance +10%. 3. If used during a Day Round, Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns: Crit Damage +30%.

name: Protection from Ra
system: (Active) Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area. 1. Reduces their Noble Phantasm Cooldown by ⅔◈ Turns. 2. Applies Buff ChUp for 1◈ Turns: the chance of applying buffs is increased by 40%.

name: Ramesseum Tentyris: Pyramid Drop
system: (Active) Range 5. Hits a 5x5 panel area for 5x damage using Base Attack (MAG), then inflicts NP Seal for 3◈ Turns and Def Dwn for 3◈ Turns (all damage received is increased by 50%). The area then becomes Day for 2◈ Turns, and Ozymandias' Skill Cooldowns are reduced by 1◈ Turns. Usable once per game; Ramesseum Tentyris can no longer be used afterwards.

name: Ramesseum Tentyris: The Shining Great Temple Complex
system: (Active) Usable after 7 full Rounds have passed. First his Master's Health is reduced by 50% of its maximum value; then an 11x11 panel area around Ozymandias becomes the Complex, clipped where it would cover an enemy Home Base.

name: The Sphinx of Abu el-Hol: The Lion-Bodied Beast of the Hot Sand
system: (Passive) Activated together with Ramesseum Tentyris. When Ramesseum Tentyris is activated, three additional Units allied with Ozymandias spawn within the Complex: the Sphinx, the Sphinx Queen and the Sphinx Wehem-Mesut. The Sphinxes do not count towards the number of Units that Move/Attack in a Turn, and the same Sphinx can only Move/Attack once per Turn. Enemy Units cannot Attack Ozymandias or his Master if any Sphinxes are next to them. The Sphinxes are able to leave Ramesseum Tentyris; when it ends or is deactivated, all Sphinxes disappear regardless of position, and if it is reactivated they respawn within the Complex with the same Stats as when they disappeared.

name: Contagion
system: (Passive) The 2 panel area around Pale Rider is the Contagion area. The effects of Contagion trigger whenever the following occurs- 1. At the end of Pale Rider's Turn: Affects all enemy Units within the Contagion area. 2. If an enemy Unit ended its Turn within the Contagion area, or at the end of a Turn an enemy Unit Acted and ended that Turn within the Contagion area: Only affects that enemy Unit. When triggered, the effects of Contagion are as follows- 1. Health is reduced by 100. Not affected by effects that modify damage taken (does not count as 'damage'). 2. Has a 50% chance of being inflicted with Poison. 3. Has a 10% chance of being inflicted with Charm for 1◈ Turns. (Active) Used during your Turn. Increases the Contagion area by a Range of 2 panels for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. When 'Doomsday Come' is Active, Contagion constantly affects all enemy Units within the NP area instead of its usual Range; and the chance of being inflicted with Poison is 75% while chance of being inflicted with Charm is 25%; and if the enemy Unit is within a 3 panel area of Pale Rider's Master, Health is reduced by 150 instead of 100.

name: Doomsday Come: Come to Me, Realm of the Dead, Come to Me
system: (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, an X panel area around Pale Rider's Master becomes the 'Doomsday Come' area, where X = (2 + number rolled on a four-sided die) for 2◈ Turns; this 'Doomsday Come' area Moves together with Pale Rider's Master. Enemy Units within the Doomsday Come area cannot leave said area, but enemy Units outside the Doomsday Come area can enter it; while allied Units can freely Move in and out of the Doomsday Come area. Units outside the Doomsday Come area cannot Attack Units within it and vice versa. After the initial NP period, Pale Rider's Master can extend the NP duration by 1◈ more Turns by reducing its Health by 100 (cannot be used if the Master's Health is less than 100), and can be repeatedly extended. During Pale Rider's Turn, if there are any enemy Units within a 2 panel area of the Doomsday Come area, Pale Rider can target an enemy Unit within this Range, that target has to perform an Evade roll. If the Evade succeeded, nothing happens. If the Evade failed, the DU is forcibly dragged into the Doomsday Come area and placed on a random panel within. Can only be used once per Turn. A Noble Phantasm of [Anti-World] or higher can be used on Doomsday Come (from outside) or within Doomsday Come. If used in this way, Doomsday Come is forcibly ended at the end of that Combat Process, and all Units within it receive the damage from that NP, but its Total Damage is reduced by 50%. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns after Doomsday Come ends.

name: Doomsday Come: Drag
system: During Pale Rider's Turn, if there are any enemy Units within a 2 panel area of the Doomsday Come area, Pale Rider can target an enemy Unit within this Range; that target has to perform an Evade roll. If the Evade succeeded, nothing happens. If the Evade failed, the DU is forcibly dragged into the Doomsday Come area and placed on a random panel within. Can only be used once per Turn.

name: Guidance of the Netherworld
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of itself. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 2. Applies Regen for 1◈ Turns, Health is restored by 10% of its maximum value at the end of the Unit's Turn, the end of any Turn the Unit Acts, and at the end of the Round. 3. Applies Dmg Cut for 1◈ Turns, 3 times; all damage taken is reduced by 100. Then, applies the 'GotN' effect to all affected Units excluding itself. The GotN effect is neither a buff or a debuff and is Unremovable. When a Unit with the 'GotN' effect enters the area of 'Doomsday Come', apply effects 1 to 3 of 'Guidance of the Netherworld' to that Unit, then remove the 'GotN' effect from that Unit. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Innocent World
system: (Passive) Constantly affects all enemy Units within 'Doomsday Come'. Applies the following effects depending on which of the Unit's Parameters are highest, as follows- 1. STR highest: All damage dealt is reduced by 50%; if NP, 25%. 2. END highest: All damage received is increased by 50%; if NP, 25%. 3. AGI highest: The value of Evade rolls are increased by 4. 4. MAG highest: Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is increased by 50% and Total Debuff Damage taken is increased by 50%. 5. LUC highest: The value of Luck Check rolls are increased by 4. 6. If the Unit has any NP whose Rank is higher than all its Parameters: The Servant is affected with NP Seal. If a Unit has no Parameters, roll a six-sided die and apply the effect corresponding to the number rolled; that Unit will receive the same effect every time it is affected by Innocent World. If the Unit has two or more Parameters of the same Rank, it is affected by all related effects. The effects of Innocent World cannot be prevented or removed as long as a Unit is within 'Doomsday Come'.

name: Kagome Kagome: Sword, Famine, Death, Beast
system: (Passive) When Doomsday Come is activated, roll a four-sided die for each enemy Unit within Doomsday Come, and summon a Kagome Spirit corresponding to the number rolled. The Kagome Spirit summoned for each enemy Unit will constantly Move towards that Unit and Attack it. Whenever a new enemy Unit enters Doomsday Come, perform this process for that Unit as well. If a damage-dealing NP or Attack that deals Light damage or Attack that deals extra damage to Units with the 'Dark' or 'Spirit' Attribute is used on a Kagome Spirit, Flip a Coin; that Kagome Spirit disappears for 1◈ Turns if Tails, and disappears for 2◈ Turns if Heads; then after that period it reappears on a random panel within Doomsday Come. Kagome Spirits do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn. The same Kagome Spirit can only Move/Attack once per Turn. When Doomsday Come ends, all Kagome Spirits immediately disappear. If Doomsday Come is activated again, the same Kagome Spirit will be summoned for the same enemy Unit if that enemy Unit was previously within Doomsday Come.

name: Charisma
system: Effects are negated and cannot be used while Mad Enhancement is active. (Passive) All damage dealt by OTHER allied Units within 2 panels is increased by 20 including NP. Negated while Penthesilea has Atk Up (Charisma) or is inflicted with Skill Seal. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up (Charisma) to herself for 1◈ Turns: allied damage within 2 panels +20%; if NP, 10%. Cooldown 4◈ Turns.

name: Goddess of War: War God's Military Sash
system: (Passive) Active only while Mad Enhancement is DEACTIVATED. Grants Penthesilea- 1. Normal Attack damage dealt +(1d4 x 10)%. 2. Damage received −(1d4 x 10)%; if NP, the magnitude is halved. 3. Evade rolls reduced by 1d4. 4. Divinity Rank raised from B to A.

name: Golden Rule (Beauty)
system: (Active) Applies Debuff Immune for 1◈ Turns (not Instakill, Death or Erase) and NP Regen for 1◈ Turns (NP Cooldown reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn).

name: Hatred of Achilles
system: At any time, if there is a Greek Male Unit (regardless of enemy or ally) within a 4 panel area around Penthesilea, her Mad Enhancement is immediately activated regardless of Cooldown or any other factors, and cannot be deactivated until no such Unit remains within 4 panels. During your Turn, Penthesilea ignores all orders/Player commands; she will constantly Move towards and Attack that Unit. This counts towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack. Can be disabled for 1◈ Turns by spending one Command Spell — which does NOT deactivate Mad Enhancement.

name: Howl of the War God
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. 1. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area. Applies Atk Up (STR) for 1◈ Turns: damage dealt which uses Base Attack (STR) is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. 2. Applied to herself. Applies Atk Up (GreekMale) for 1◈ Turns: damage dealt to Male Units from the Greece region is increased by 100% including NP. Cooldown 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Outrage Amazon: A Hero to Die on My Rage
system: Only usable when Mad Enhancement is activated. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 3.5x damage and inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 30%. Cooldown 6◈ Turns.

name: Bab-ilu: Key of the King's Law To Enshrine
system: Rank: E~A++ (Passive) Whenever Proto Gil Attacks an enemy Unit at a Range of 2 or higher, he can Move to any panel that is directly next to the DU and perform an additional Normal Attack on that DU; if the DU Blocked the first Attack, it also has to Block the second Attack, while if the DU successfully Evaded the first Attack, it has a choice to Block or Evade the second Attack. (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 3x damage. Then, all affected DUs roll 3 twenty-sided dice and are inflicted with the corresponding debuffs for 1◈ Turns- 1. Atk Dwn 30%; if NP, 15% 2. Def Dwn 30% 3. Crit Dwn 30% 4. Crit DmDwn 30% 5. NP DmDwn 30% 6. Debuff ResDwn 30% 7. Debuff ChDwn 30% 8. Buff ChDwn 30% 9. No Buff (1 time per number of dice which rolled a 9) 10. NP Seal 11. Skill Seal 12. AGL Dwn (+3) 13. LUC Dwn (+3) 14. MOV Dwn (-3) 15. TEC Dwn (-3) 16. Bal Dwn 30% 17. Heal Dwn 30% 18. NP Degen 19. Terror 30% 20. Decoy. If the same number is rolled, that debuff is applied the same amount of times its number is rolled; for debuffs which do not stack, its duration is extended instead. Gilgamesh's Master loses Health equivalent to if an E Rank NP is used. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Charisma
system: (Passive) All damage dealt by other allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself is increased by 27 including NP. This effect is negated if this Unit has Atk Up (Charisma) or is inflicted with Skill Seal. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up (Charisma) for 1◈ Turns to himself, all damage dealt by allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself is increased by 25%; if NP, 10%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Enki: Sword of the End
system: Surge of Utnapishtim. When this NP is Activated, Proto Gil's Master's Health is reduced by half of its maximum value (instead of the normal Master's Health cost); this NP cannot be used when his Master's Health is below or equal to half of its maximum value; and Proto Gil cannot Act for 1◈ Turns after this NP is Activated. When used, the panel which Proto Gil was standing on gains the 'Utnapishtim' mark. 7◈ Turns after Enki was Activated, it hits a 13x13 panel area centered on the 'Utnapishtim' panel for 5x damage plus 700 (Base Attack (MAG) is used) and has a 500% chance of inflicting Drowning for 3◈ Turns. Water damage. Then, the area affected by this NP becomes a 'Waterside' area for 7◈ Turns. Proto Gil, his Master, Units with the 'Levitating' Attribute, Noah and all Noah's allied Units within a 2 panel area of Noah are not affected by this NP. Can only be used once during the entire game. If Proto Gil is defeated during those 7◈ Turns after Enki's Activation (and before it hits the board), the NP is cancelled.

name: Enkidu: Chains of Heaven
system: Rank: ??? Range=3. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals normal damage and has a 50% chance of inflicting Stun for 1◈ Turns. Damage dealt and chance of inflicting Stun increases the higher the Divinity Rank of the DU. Rank EX: Damage dealt increased by 150%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 100%. Rank A: Damage dealt increased by 100%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 50%. Rank B: Damage dealt increased by 80%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 40%. Rank C: Damage dealt increased by 60%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 30%. Rank D: Damage dealt increased by 40%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 20%. Rank E: Damage dealt increased by 20%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 10%. If the DU has the 'Divine' Attribute but no 'Divinity' Skill, treat it as if it has Rank A Divinity. Additionally, if the DU has the 'Divine' Attribute, Debuff Immune effects cannot prevent Stun from being inflicted, even those which specifically affect Stun (Debuff Resist can still reduce the chance). Does not decrease Master's Health when used. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns

name: Golden Rule
system: (Passive) Whenever Gilgamesh performs a Crit, reduce his NP Cooldown by 1 Turn. If none of his NP are on Cooldown, reduce the Turn count of Enki by 1 Turn if it has been activated. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 2 Turns at the end of every Turn. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Levitation
system: (Passive 1) Proto Gil's MOV is increased by 1 (5 panels to 6). (Passive 2) When Proto Gil Moves, he can Move through obstacles (e.g. enemy Units) but still cannot enter the area around an enemy Master if…see 'Master-Servant Relationships'. (Passive 3) Proto Gil's Agility Check rolls are reduced by 3. (Passive 4) Proto Gil gains the 'Levitating' Attribute. These effects are negated if Proto Gil is inflicted with NP Seal.

name: Treasury of Babylon
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Reduce Gilgamesh's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns, then applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 60%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Charisma of the Sun
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. 2. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, Crit Chance is increased by 25%. 3. Applies the Sol buff to herself for 1◈ Turns, its effects are as follows- The 5x5 panel area around Quetz is 'Day', even if it is during a Night Round. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Ehecatle
system: Damage Spell. Can only be used while Riding Quetzalcoatlus. Range=4. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 2x damage and inflicts Sap for 1◈ Turns. Wind damage. Counts as Quetz's & Quetzalcoatlus' Attack for the Turn. Cannot be used as a Counter.

name: Goddess's Divine Core
system: (Passive 1) All damage dealt is increased by 120 including NP. (Passive 2) Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is decreased by 50%. This Skill counts as 'Divinity'.

name: Good God's Wisdom
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Used on an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of Quetz. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts for 1◈ Turns, when the Unit is defeated it is revived with 10% of its Max Health. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Lucha Libre
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Crit Up for ⅓◈, Crit Chance is increased by 60%. 2. Applies Crit DmUp for ⅓◈, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 50%. 3. Reduces the Cooldown of Xiuhcoatl by 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Piedra Del Sol: The Sun Stone
system: (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, the Piedra Del Sol appears where Quetz is. While the Piedra Del Sol is above the field, it has the following effects- 1. Goddess' Divine Core: All damage dealt is increased by 180; and all damage taken by Quetz is reduced by 50% including NP. 2. When an enemy Unit ends its Turn within the 7x7 panel area around the Piedra Del Sol, it receives 50 Fire damage and is inflicted with Burn; this Burn debuff is permanent as long as the Unit is within the Piedra Del Sol area. (The Piedra Del Sol area is categorized as 'Burning'.) Quetz can Move out of the Piedra Del Sol area, and the panel occupied by Piedra Del Sol can still be Moved onto (replace the Piedra Del Sol on top of any Units which Move onto that panel). After every 1◈ Turns, Quetz's Master's Health is reduced by 50 at the end of the Turn if this NP is Active unless the NP was deactivated during this Round. If her Master's Health drops to/is 50 or less at any time, this NP is forcefully deactivated at the end of the Turn. This NP can be deactivated during Quetz's Turn or at the start or end of any Round or Turn. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns after Piedra Del Sol was deactivated.

name: Tlaelquiyahuitl
system: Damage Spell. Can only be used while Riding Quetzalcoatlus. Range=4. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 2x damage and inflicts Slow for 2◈ Turns. Water damage. Counts as Quetz's & Quetzalcoatlus' Attack for the Turn. Cannot be used as a Counter.

name: Tlahuitequiliztli
system: Damage Spell. Can only be used while Riding Quetzalcoatlus. Range=4. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 2x damage and inflicts Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Counts as Quetz's & Quetzalcoatlus' Attack for the Turn. Cannot be used as a Counter.

name: Quetzalcoatl: Winged Serpent
system: (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, Quetz summons a Quetzalcoatlus at her position, and she is Moved onto the Quetzalcoatlus together with her Master (if her Master is next to the Quetzalcoatlus; otherwise her Master can get on the Quetzalcoatlus at any time). While Quetz is Riding the Quetzalcoatlus, Quetz's Move and Normal Attack is replaced with Quetzalcoatlus'. Quetz or her Master cannot be targeted for an Attack while they are Riding the Quetzalcoatlus. If they are hit with an AoE Attack, the Quetzalcoatlus receives full damage, Quetz receives 50% Total Damage while her Master receives no damage and effects. The Quetzalcoatlus ignores obstacles while Moving, and can Move onto occupied panels (place the Quetzalcoatlus on top of anything occupying said panels). While Quetz is Riding the Quetzalcoatlus, she is able to use the three Spells listed below. After every 1◈ Turns, Quetz's Master's Health is reduced by 25 at the end of the Turn if this NP is Active unless the NP was deactivated during this Round. If her Master's Health is 25 or less, this NP is forcefully deactivated at the end of the Round. This NP can be deactivated during Quetz's Turn or at the start or end of any Round or Turn, but cannot be deactivated for 2◈ Turns after it was activated. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns after Quetzalcoatlus is defeated.

name: Xiuhcoatl: O Flame, Burn the Gods Themselves
system: Range+2. Base Attack (STR) and half of Base Attack (MAG) is used (BA=250), not affected by Magic Resistance. Deals 4x damage and inflicts NP Seal for 1◈ Turns, and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage (half). Then (regardless of whether the NP hits the DU or not), deals normal damage to all Units within a 2 panel area of the targeted Unit except Quetzalcoatl and the targeted Unit (Base Attack (MAG) is used) with a 25% chance of inflicting NP Seal for 1◈ Turns and inflicts Burn for 1◈ Turns. Fire damage. Xiuhcoatl cannot be used if Quetz is Riding the Quetzalcoatlus. If this NP is used on a Unit within or directly next to a [Fortress] NP (regardless of ally's or enemy's), that NP area and the panels directly outside/next to the NP area are now 'Burning' until the Fortress NP is deactivated. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns.

name: Goō Shōriki・Dohatsu Tenshou
system: Ox King's Power: Rising Fury. Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is Active. Range=3. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range. First, deal 0.5x damage four times using Base Attack (STR), each instance of damage respectively being Lightning damage (half), Fire damage (half), Ice damage (half) and Wind damage (half). Each of these four Attacks can be separately Blocked or Evaded; treat these Attacks as Normal Attacks. These 4 Attacks are not affected by Mad Enhancement. Then, deals 3.5x damage plus 200 using Base Attack (MAG) and inflicts Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Treat this part as the Noble Phantasm. Then, inflict Crit Dwn on all affected Units for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 20%. Cooldown: 6◈+⅔◈ Turns. If used while Goō Shōrai・Tenmōkaikai is Active, it is immediately ended at the end of that Combat Phase, and its Cooldown is increased by 2◈ Turns.

name: Genji-clan Martial Arts Discipline
system: (Passive) The magnitude of all Atk Dwn effects on Raikou is halved. (Active) Applies Crit Up (Martial) to Raikou for 1◈ Turns; if Mad Enhancement is Active, Crit Chance is increased by 30%, and if it is not, by 60%. Then applies Crit DmUp (Martial) to Raikou for 1◈ Turns, 3 times; if Mad Enhancement is Active, Crit Damage is increased by 30%, and if it is not, by 60%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Mana Burst (Lightning)
system: (Passive) Raikou is Immune to Shock. All Lightning damage taken is reduced by 50% including NP. (Active) Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is not Active. This Skill is used when Raikou performs a Normal Attack. For that Combat Process, the Base Attack used is her BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (BA=350), and the Attack inflicts Shock for 2◈ Turns. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Lightning damage (half). Then, applies Dodge to herself for ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Mystery Slayer
system: (Passive 1) All damage dealt to Units with the '[Earth]' or '[Sky]' Attribute is increased by 20% including NP. (Passive 2) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute is increased by 20% including NP. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up (MS) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the '[Earth]' or '[Sky]' Attribute is increased by 30% including NP; and applies Atk Up (Demonic) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute is increased by 30% including NP. Note: Mystery Slayer and Atk Up (MS) have no effect on 'Demi-Servants' and 'Pseudo-Servants' except Sitonai. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Goō Shōrai・Tenmōkaikai
system: (Non-damaging/Passive) Ox-King Storm Call: The Inescapable Net of Heaven. Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is deactivated (Mad Enhancement can be reactivated after this NP is activated). Raikou summons four extra clones of herself on the panels in front of her, behind her, and her left and right.
