The clones have the same Max Agility, Max Luck and MOV as Raikou, but half her Max Health; they cannot use Mad Enhancement, Riding or the Active effects of Raikou's Skills (Passive effects are still present), and can only perform Normal Attacks. During the NP duration, Raikou's Attacks deal 50% extra damage and inflict Shock for 2◈ Turns, Lightning damage (half). Raikou's Crit Chance is increased by 30%, the copies' by 15%. At the end of Raikou's Turn and at the end of any Turn Raikou or any of her copies Acts, Raikou's Master loses 25 Health. This NP is forcefully deactivated if Raikou's Master has 25 Health or less and would lose Health due to this effect; her Master does not lose Health on the same Turn this NP is deactivated. It is also forcefully deactivated at the end of a Turn Raikou is defeated. Raikou's copies do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn, and the same copy can only Move/Attack once per Turn. Enemy Units cannot Attack Raikou or her Master if any Raikou copies are next to them. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns after this NP is deactivated or after the last Raikou copy is defeated.

name: Thunder God's Embodiment
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is Active. 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 2. Applies Dodge for ⅓◈ Turns. 3. Applies the Raikou buff for 3 times: Normal Attacks deal 40 bonus Lightning damage with a 40% chance of inflicting Shock for ⅔◈ Turns, and reduce her NP Cooldown by ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Brahmastra: Rakshasa-Piercing Immortal
system: Base Attack (STR) is used. Range=3. Deals 5x damage. This NP has the following effects depending on the DU- With 'Demonic' Attribute: Damage dealt is further increased by 200%. Without 'Demonic' Attribute: Total Damage dealt is reduced by 20%. Then, has the following effects- 1. Inflicts Def Dwn (B) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%; if NP, 30%. 2. If the DU has the 'Demonic' Attribute, its NP Cooldown is increased by 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns

name: Curse of Separation
system: (Passive) When Rama would be defeated and is not revived by any effect, for every Reunion Counter on himself, he has a 3% chance of having that Attack be canceled, then Sita is summoned on a panel directly next to himself (will be contracted to Rama's Master). Can only activate once per game.

name: Dream of Reunion
system: (Passive) Whenever Rama is defeated and revived with an effect, gain 1 Reunion Counter. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts for 1◈ Turns, when Rama is defeated, he is revived with 100 Health. 2. Restores Rama's Health by 25% of its maximum value. 3. NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈ Turns. 4. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 5. Gain 1 Reunion Counter. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Martial Blessing
system: (Passive) Allows the use of Vishnu Bhuja. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 50%; and applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage is increased by 100%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Modhaki and Shikhari (Normal Attack)
system: (Passive) Once per Round, Rama can perform a Normal Attack which deals 20% extra damage.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Modhaki and Shikhari
system: (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. Range=1. Deals 4x damage and inflicts Immobilize for 1◈+⅓◈ Turns. Earth damage (half). All Units except Rama standing directly around the DU (1 panel) receive 2x damage with a 50% chance of being inflicted with Immobilize for ⅔◈ Turns. Earth damage. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns. This NP is treated as a Rank A NP.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Pinaka (Normal Attack)
system: (Passive) Once per Round, Rama can perform a Normal Attack at a Range of 5. If he does, roll a twelve-sided die at the end of the Damage Step. If a 5 is rolled, the Shiva Dhanush is broken, Vishnu Bhuja: Pinaka can no longer be used for the rest of the game.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Pinaka
system: Shiva Dhanush: Bow of Shiva. (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. Range=5. Deals 5x damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns. When this NP is used, roll a 6-sided die at the end of the Damage Step. If a 5 is rolled, the Shiva Dhanush is broken, Vishnu Bhuja: Pinaka can no longer be used for the rest of the game. Fire damage (half). Cooldown: 7◈ Turns. This NP is treated as a Rank A NP.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Shuuravara (Normal Attack)
system: (Passive) Once per Round, Rama can perform a Normal Attack at a Range of 3. Damage dealt is reduced by 20%.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Shuuravara
system: (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. Range=4. Deals 3.5x damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Slow for 2◈ Turns; then inflict Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 10%. Water damage (half). Cooldown: 5◈ Turns. This NP is treated as a Rank A NP.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Sudarshana (Normal Attack)
system: (Passive) Once per Round, Rama can perform a Normal Attack at a Range of 4. Damage dealt is reduced by 30%.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Sudarshana
system: (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. Range=3. Targets 2 enemy Units within Range. Deals 3x damage to both of them with a 20% chance of inflicting Bleed for 1◈+⅓◈ Turns. Wind damage (half). Cooldown: 5◈ Turns. This NP is treated as a Rank A NP.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Trishula (Normal Attack)
system: (Passive) Once per Round, Rama can perform a Normal Attack at a Range of 2.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Trishula
system: (Active) Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Rama for 3x damage with a 30% chance of inflicting Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns. This NP is treated as a Rank A NP.

name: Vishnu Bhuja: Arms of the Great One
system: When Rama is summoned, Flip a Coin. If Heads, roll 2 six-sided die; if Tails, roll 1 six-sided die. The number(s) rolled on the di(c)e determines which of the following additional Noble Phantasms Rama possesses during the game: 1 Sudarshana, 2 Shuuravara, 3 Modhaki and Shikhari, 4 Trishula, 5 Pinaka. Note: If a 6 is rolled, the player can choose any of the available Noble Phantasms (that hasn't been chosen yet). A double other than 6 rolls its second die again.

name: Ár
system: Primordial Rune Spell. Range 2. Used during your Turn on an allied Unit within Range. Restores 4 Agility, then applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns: damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 30%. Cooldown 3◈ Turns. Can only be used once per Turn.

name: Gáe Bolg Alternative: Soaring Spear of Piercing Death
system: Base Attack (STR) is used. Range 4. Has a 500% chance of inflicting Stun for 1◈ Turns; then has a 75% chance of inflicting Instakill. If Instakill is not inflicted, this NP deals 3.5x damage plus 100. Cooldown 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Gate of Skye: Gate to the Magical Realm Brimming with Death
system: Affects all of Scáthach's targets of choice within a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to her. All targeted Units perform a Luck Check; if their MAG is Rank B, the value rolled is reduced by 2, and if their MAG is Rank A, by 4. If the targeted Unit's Luck Check fails, it is inflicted with Death. If it succeeds, it receives 4x damage plus 100, using Scáthach's Base Attack (MAG). Masters can be targeted regardless of their distance from their Servant. Cooldown 7◈+⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Primordial Rune, Wisdom of Dún Scáith and/or Gáe Bolg Alternative are on Cooldown; when this NP is used, Primordial Rune and Wisdom of Dún Scáith enter Cooldown.

name: God Slayer
system: (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Undead' or 'Divine' Attribute is increased by 30%, including NP. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Dmg Up (Gods) for 1◈ Turns — damage dealt to Units with the 'Undead' or 'Divine' Attribute is further increased by 70% — and applies the 'Alpi' buff for 1◈ Turns, 3 times. Cooldown 4◈ Turns.

name: Primordial Rune Spells
system: (Passive 1) If Scáthach uses a Primordial Rune Spell while she has any PRS Tokens, remove one PRS Token from herself, and the Primordial Rune Spell she used does not enter Cooldown. The maximum number of PRS Tokens Scáthach can have is 2. (Passive 2) When one of Scáthach's Primordial Rune Spells is used, the other two cannot be used until Cooldown has ended for the used Spell.

name: Primordial Rune
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Gain 2 PRS Tokens. Then, on an allied Unit within 2 panels or on an enemy Unit within Range 2, roll two eight-sided dice and apply the corresponding effects from the allied or enemy table. If a duplicate number is rolled, apply the effect twice.

name: Þurs
system: Primordial Rune Spell. Damage Spell. Range 3. Deals 2x damage and inflicts Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Cooldown 2◈ Turns.

name: Úr
system: Primordial Rune Spell. Damage Spell. Range 3. Deals 2x damage and inflicts Slow for 1◈ Turns. Water damage. Cooldown 2◈ Turns.

name: Wisdom of Dún Scáith: Clairvoyance
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has an 80% chance of applying Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns (Crit Damage +50%), an 80% chance of applying Crit Up for 1◈ Turns (Crit Chance +50%), and applies Dodge for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Wisdom of Dún Scáith (Skill 1) or (Skill 2) is on Cooldown.

name: Wisdom of Dún Scáith
system: When Scáthach is Summoned, she is given a list of Skills (preferably Rank B to Rank A) that must have an Active effect, of all other Servants on the field, excluding Class Skills. She selects two of them and uses their effects as effects of this Skill. Rank EX Skills cannot be copied. Neither can Skills a Servant is physically born with, Skills that are part of their body, or Skills unique to one Servant — Natural Body, 'Mystic Eye' Skills, 'Mana Burst' Skills, Kishu no Ma, Affections of the Holy Grail.

name: Arrogant King's Poison
system: (Active) Requires 3 [Semiramis' Poison] to use. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range. Inflicts Poison on all affected Units, and also inflicts Def Dwn (B) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 30%; if NP, 40%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Double Summon: Caster
system: (Trigger) When Semiramis is summoned, Flip a Coin. If Heads, she is summoned with the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill (i.e. this Skill). If Tails, she does not have this Skill. (Passive 1) If Semiramis has Double Summon: Caster, her Range is 3 panels, 1 target. At a Range of 1 to 2, her Normal Attacks use Base Attack (STR). At a Range of 3 or higher, her Normal Attacks use Base Attack (MAG). (Passive 2) If Semiramis does not have Double Summon: Caster, her Range is 2 panels, 1 target. Normal Attacks use Base Attack (STR). (Passive) Semiramis is both a 'Caster' and 'Assassin' Class Servant.

name: Double Summon
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies the 'Construction' effect for 1◈ Turns- HGoB Construction is increased by 1d6 at the end of every Turn. The 'Construction' effect is neither a buff or debuff and is Unremovable. 3. If Semiramis does not have the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill, she gains the 'DSC' buff for 1◈ Turns, this buff grants her the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill.

name: Familiar: Doves
system: (Passive) Whenever Semiramis sees a Unit for the first time, the 'Dove' effect is applied to it (neither a buff nor a debuff, is Unremovable). Semiramis can see the position of all Units with the 'Dove' effect on the field, regardless of Fog of War (but the effect does not remove Fog of War for her). (Active) Used during your Turn. Range=4. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range. Inflicts Debuff ResDwn for 1/3◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted with debuffs is increased by 30%; then reduce Semiramis' NP Cooldown by X Turns, where X=number of enemy Units on the board with the 'Dove' effect (max Cooldown reduction=1◈ Turns).

name: Hanging Gardens of Babylon: Aerial Garden of Vanity
system: (Activation) Only in effect and usable if Semiramis was summoned with the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. Hanging Gardens of Babylon (HGoB) can only be used when the HGoB Construction counter reaches 100. In order to activate the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Semiramis has to be within her Home Base, and cannot Act for 3◈ Turns. If Semiramis is Attacked during this period, the period of 3◈ Turns is interrupted and she has to restart the activation process. If Semiramis is not interrupted, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon is activated at the end of the last Turn in that period. Semiramis' Master only loses Health as per NP usage rules only when HGoB successfully activates, not at the start of the NP activation process. However, Semiramis can perform the activation without being in her Master's ZON.

name: Aerial Garden of Vanity
system: Range=7. Cannot hit under or above the HGoB. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 7x7 panel area within Range for 2x damage. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Dragon Wing Warriors
system: Range=4 plus the area under the HGoB and the area of the HGoB. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Range. All affected Units receive 50 Fixed STR damage X times, where X=Number rolled on a six-sided die plus 4. Each instance of damage can be separately Evaded or Blocked. Damaged Units only perform an Injury Roll once regardless of number of hits taken. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns.

name: Item Construction
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Roll a four-sided die; Semiramis creates that number of [Semiramis' Poison] Items.

name: [Semiramis' Poison]
system: Whenever Semiramis is standing directly next to an allied Unit, any number of [Semiramis' Poison] can be passed from Semiramis to that Unit (once per Turn). Consuming 1 grants the 'Queen's Poison' effect for 3◈ Turns.

name: Scales of the Sacred Fish
system: Spell. Used at the start of a Combat Phase when Semiramis or an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of herself is Attacked; the Unit gains the Shield (200) buff for 2◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Sikera Ušum: Arrogant King's Alcohol
system: Has different effects depending on whether Semiramis was summoned with the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. 1. If Semiramis was not summoned with it: When this NP is used, it affects the 5x5 panel area around her (which Moves with her) for 2◈ Turns. 2. If Semiramis was summoned with it: Can only be used within the 'Throne Room' of 'Hanging Gardens of Babylon'. Affects the Throne Room for 3◈ Turns, and all Units within the Throne Room when the NP was activated cannot leave it while it is Active. The effects of this NP area are as follows- a. Semiramis' Normal Attacks which use Base Attack (STR) inflict Poison. b. When a Unit other than Semiramis or her Master Acts then ends its Turn within the NP area, it is inflicted with Poison. c. Units inflicted with Poison while within this NP area receive Poison damage at the end of its Turn and at the end of any Turn it Acts, in addition to at the end of the Round. d. When a Unit with Poison Immune effects is in this NP area, the Poison Immune effect is reduced to a Poison Resist effect, the chance of being inflicted with Poison is reduced by 75%. Units with Poison Resist effects that are not Poison Immune in this area have the magnitude of those Poison Resist effects halved. Only applies to effects that specify Poison. e. Units in the NP area who are weak to Poison receive double Poison Damage (in addition to any other effects they might have which increase Poison Damage received). Does not apply to external debuffs or effects affecting said Units. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns after the NP ends.

name: Summoning: Bašmu
system: Spell. Can only be used when Semiramis has the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. Has different effects depending on whether Semiramis is within her 'Hanging Gardens of Babylon' or not. 1. If used when she is not within her HGoB: Damage Spell. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 25% extra damage and inflicts Poison. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. 2. If used when within her HGoB: Semiramis summons a Bašmu on a panel directly next to her. Counts as her Attack for the Turn. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Territory Creation
system: Has different effects depending on whether Semiramis has the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. 1. If Semiramis has it, the effects of Territory Creation are reduced to Rank C for her Faction's Home Base. Territory Creation Rank EX is only applied to the whole area of Semiramis' 'Hanging Gardens of Babylon'. (Passive 1) When this Unit is in its Home Base, all damage dealt by it is increased by 6d20, including NP. (Passive 2) While this Unit is on the field, all damage taken by allied Units who are in their Home Base is further reduced by (3d10+30), including NP. 2. If Semiramis does not have it, when she uses the 'Double Summon' Skill, she gains the effects of Territory Creation Rank C while she has the 'DSC' buff. Note: If there are multiple allied Units with this Skill, only the Territory Creation with the highest Rank takes effect.

name: Danse Macabre
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. 1. Applies Debuff ChUp for 1◈ Turns; chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by 40%. 2. Applies Death ChUp for 1◈ Turns; chance of inflicting Instakill and Death is increased by 40%. 3. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns; all damage dealt is increased by 30%, if NP 20%. 4. Applies the 'Macabre' buff for 1◈ Turns; Serenity's Normal Attack Crits inflict an additional Stage of Poison on the Defending Unit. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Projectile (Poisoned Daggers)
system: (Passive 1) Crit Chance is increased by 15%. (Passive 2) Normal Attacks inflict Poison on the Defending Unit. (Passive 3) Normal Attacks have a 25% chance of inflicting Deadly Poison for 1◈ Turns; Poison Damage received is doubled.

name: Shapeshift (Infiltration Specialization)
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Increase its NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns and inflicts Crit Down for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Can be used when Presence Concealment is Active, and has a 20% chance of deactivating Presence Concealment when used.

name: Silent Dance
system: (Passive) Chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by 10%. Chance of inflicting Instakill and Death is increased by 10%.

name: Zabaniya: Delusional Poison Body
system: (Passive 1) Serenity is Immune to Poison and Deadly Poison. (Passive 2) Any Unit within a 2 panel area of Serenity is inflicted with Poison at the end of her Turn. While Presence Concealment is Active they are inflicted with Secret Poison instead, where the debuff and the total Poison Damage taken is only revealed after Presence Concealment is deactivated. (Active) Range=1. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Deals 3x damage plus 100, not affected by Magic Resistance. After dealing damage: inflicts Stage 3 Poison on the Defending Unit; inflicts Deadly Poison for 2◈ Turns, Poison Damage received is doubled; 40% chance to inflict Skill Seal for 1◈ Turns; 40% chance to inflict NP Seal for 1◈ Turns; 60% chance to inflict Instakill. Cooldown: 5◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Akafiloga Argrise: Incandescent Dragon's Breath・Earth Liquefaction
system: Usage 1. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Sieg. First inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns on all affected Units, all damage taken is increased by 30%; then deals 5x damage. Fire damage. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns. As Fafnir: its Def Dwn is 50%; the transformation ends at the end of the Turn it was used, and Sieg's Master loses Health as per when a Servant uses its NP, doubled. Note: cannot be used while Usage 2 is on Cooldown.

name: Akafiloga Argrise: Fafnir
system: Usage 2 (Activation/Non-damaging). Sieg transforms into Fafnir. As Fafnir: a. Max & current Health is increased by 300% (quadrupled). b. Base Attack (STR) is increased by 150, Base Attack (MAG) is increased by 125. c. All damage taken is reduced by 75%; if NP, 50%. No Injury Rolls when damaged by an Attack unless by an NP. d. Cannot Block; when he performs an Agility Check, double the value of the roll. e. Can Move to any panel; Units on panels he Moves into are knocked back by 1 panel until he can stand there. f. Gains the 'Large' Attribute. He is 3x3. g. At the end of every Turn this NP is Active, Sieg's Master loses 40 Health if Fafnir Acted, 20 if he did not (instead of the usual NP cost). If the Master's Health is not above that, the NP ends at that Turn's end and the Master loses nothing. h. Cannot use any Skill or NP but Usage 1. j. Sieg can end it during his Turn, or at the start or end of any Turn or Round. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns after it ends. Cannot be used while Usage 1 is on Cooldown.

name: Blasted Tree: The Lightning Tree of Crucifixion
system: Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range=1. Deals 2.5x damage to the DU, then all Units within a 3x3 panel area of the DU other than Sieg receive 1.5x damage (these DUs can Evade/Block, but cannot Counter). Has a 25% chance of inflicting Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Bridal Chest: A Maiden's Chastity
system: (Passive 1) At a Range of 1, Sieg's Normal Attacks use his Base Attack (STR). At a Range of 2 or higher, Sieg's Normal Attacks use his Base Attack (MAG) and deal Lightning damage with a 10% chance of inflicting Shock for 1◈ Turns. If Sieg is affected with NP Seal, his Range is reduced to 1 for the duration of NP Seal. (Passive 2) After every 3 full Rounds, increase Sieg's Max and current Agility by 1 (maximum increase = 4), and Base Attack (both) by 10 (no limit) at the end of the Round. (Passive 3) Sieg gains the 'Galvanism' Skill.

name: Dead Count Shapeshifter: Siegfried
system: (Active) Usage 2. Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase. Requires 1 DRCS to use. When this Skill is used, reduce Sieg's DRCS by 1, then Sieg is transformed into Siegfried, with all Skills and NP available and usable (although NP can only be used if the number of Rounds passed meets the game conditions). Roll a four-sided die. Sieg's transformation into Siegfried lasts for X Turns, where X=(1◈+[½◈*Number rolled on the four-sided die]). When Sieg transforms into 'Siegfried', he keeps all buffs, debuffs, and other effects that were affecting him before he transformed. When the transformation ends, 'Siegfried' transforms back into Sieg with his Stats and Skill/Spell/NP Cooldowns the same as they were before he transformed, then his Health is reduced by 100 (Sieg's Health cannot drop below 1 in this way). Cooldown: 3◈ Turns plus the number of Turns Sieg was transformed for, after the transformation ends. Note: New Stats have to be rolled for the transformed Sieg. Any + or - to Sieg's Parameters are carried over to the transformed Sieg.

name: Dead Count Shapeshifter: Dragon Revelation
system: (Active) When Sieg is summoned, he has three Dragon Revelation Command Spells (DRCS). Usage 1: Used during your Turn. Reduces Sieg's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns and applies Dmg Up (Dragon) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is increased by 100%; if NP, 50%. Then, this Skill has a 25% chance of consuming one of Sieg's DRCS. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. This usage of this Skill can be used while Sieg has no DRCS left, but NP Cooldown is only reduced by ½◈ Turns, and Dmg Up (Dragon) increases the damage dealt to 'Dragon' Attribute Units by 50%; if NP, 25%.

name: Galvanism
system: (Passive) Granted by Bridal Chest. Whenever Sieg takes MAG damage, his NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns, and the Cooldown of one random Straße/gehen Spell is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns. This Skill is in effect even while Sieg is transformed into Siegfried. This effect is negated while affected with NP Seal.

name: Straße/gehen: Heilen
system: Spell. Used during your Turn. Used on an allied Unit within a 3 panel area of himself. Restores the affected Unit's Health by 15% of its maximum value and Agility by 1. If used on himself, his Health is instead restored by 30% of its maximum value and Agility is restored by 2. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Homunculus
system: (Passive) Has the following effects- 1. All STR damage dealt is increased by 5%. 2. All MAG damage dealt is increased by 10%. 3. Chance of being inflicted with debuffs is reduced by 5%.

name: Straße/gehen: Knacken
system: Spell. Range=3. Used during your Turn on an enemy Unit; or at the start of a Combat Phase on the DU (needs to be within Range). Inflict Def Dwn (Knacken) for 1◈ Turns on the enemy Unit, all damage taken is increased by 50% including NP on the Turn this Spell is used, then its magnitude is reduced to 25% at the end of the Turn the Spell was used. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Magecraft
system: Allows the use of Straße/gehen Spells. Only one Straße/gehen Spell can be used per Turn.

name: Man-made Hero (False)
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies Max HpUp for 1◈ Turns, Max Health is increased by 20% of its original value. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Straße/gehen: Schwert
system: Spell. Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase. Applies Atk Up to himself for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 35%; if NP, 25%. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Armor of Fafnir: Blood Armor of the Evil Dragon
system: (Passive) Has several effects- 1. Damage from all Normal Attacks, (Attack) Skills, and (Damage) Spells received from Units with a STR Rank or MAG Rank of B or lower are completely nullified. Damage from all Normal Attacks, Attack Skills, and Spells that are able to damage Siegfried have their Total damage reduced by 75%. 2. Damage from all damage-dealing Noble Phantasms used on Siegfried with a Rank of B+ or lower is completely nullified. Total Damage from all damage-inflicting Noble Phantasms used on Siegfried which are able to damage him is reduced by 75%. 3. Effects 1 & 2 are ignored/bypassed if the Attack, (Attack) Skill, (Damage) Spell, Noble Phantasm or the AU has an 'Anti-Dragon' effect (i.e. deals extra damage to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute). 4. Effects 1 & 2 is ignored/bypassed if Siegfried is Attacked from behind/his back. If Siegfried takes damage from being Attacked from behind, both his Max Health and current Health are reduced, instead of just current Health. Def Up, Dmg Cut, Invuln, and any other damage reducing effects on Siegfried do not apply if he is Attacked from behind. 5. Effects 1 and 2 are negated if Siegfried is affected by NP Seal.

name: Avaricious Gold
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Apply the 'Rheingold' buff for 1◈ Turns, a successful activation of 'Golden Rule' reduces NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns instead of 1 Turn. 2. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 3. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Balmung: Phantasmal Greatsword, Felling of the Sky Demon
system: Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 5x3 or 3x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Siegfried for 5x damage, damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is further increased by 200%. Then, if Siegfried had any 'Anti-Dragon' effects (any buffs/effects which increase damage dealt/reduce damage taken from 'Dragon' Attribute Units), apply NP Regen (Balmung) to Siegfried for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn for every Anti-Dragon effect on himself. Note: Passive Anti-Dragon effects do not count. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: Dragon Slayer
system: (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is increased by 20%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies the following effects- 1. Applies Ward (Dragon) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received from Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is reduced by 30%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Dragon) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is further increased by 60%. 3. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅔◈ Turns.

name: Curse of Separation
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts for 1◈ Turns, when Sita is defeated she is revived with 100 Health. 2. Restore Sita's Health by 25% of its maximum value. 3. Applies Regen to herself for 1◈ Turns, Sita's Health is restored by 5% of its maximum value at the end of her Turn, at the end of a Turn she Acts, and at the end of the Round. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Goddess's Divine Core
system: (Passive 1) All damage dealt is increased by 60 including NP. (Passive 2) Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is decreased by 20%. (Passive 3) Whenever Sita uses a Skill, apply the 'Janaka' buff to herself for 1◈ Turns, its effects are as follows- When Sita performs a Normal Attack, it uses her Base Attack (STR) and 20% of her Base Attack (MAG) combined (i.e. 75+40=115), the amount of Base Attack (MAG) used increases by 20% for each 'Janaka' buff on Sita; while the effect of Magic Resistance is reduced to X%, where X%=the amount of Base Attack (MAG) used. Whenever the 'Janaka' buff is applied to herself, the duration of all 'Janaka' buffs on herself are reset. This Skill counts as 'Divinity'.

name: Haradhanu Janaka: Peerless Bow of Reminiscence
system: Range=7. Base Attack (MAG) is used. First, removes all debuffs from Sita, then deals 3.5x damage. Next, apply Heal Up for 1◈ Turns to Sita, when Sita's Health is restored, the amount restored is increased by 50%. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.

name: Jewel of the Earth
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is reduced by 20%; if NP, 10%; and applies Debuff Immune for 1◈ Turns, 2 times; does not affect Instakill, Death, and Erase. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Pilgrimage in Agni Pariksha
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Decoy to herself for ⅔◈ Turns. 2. Applies Invuln to herself for 1◈ Turns, 3 times. 3. Applies Burn Immune to herself for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Summoning: Elder Horror
system: Spell. Can be used as a Counter. Summons an Elder Horror on a panel next to Gilles. Counts as Gilles' Attack for the Turn. The Elder Horror has 300 Health, 13 Agility, 7 Luck, Range=2, MOV=4 and Base Attack (STR) is 125, Detect=3 panels. Elder Horrors have the 'Dark (Outsider)' Attribute. Elder Horrors do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn. The same Elder Horror can only Move/Attack once per Turn. When an Elder Horror is defeated, Gilles rolls a four-sided die. If a 3 is rolled, the defeated Elder Horror turns into three new Horrors. This effect does not activate if the Elder Horror was defeated with Light damage or an Attack that deals extra damage to 'Dark' or 'Outsider' Attribute Units. Enemy Units cannot Attack Gilles or his Master if there are any Elder Horrors directly next to them. Cannot be used if Prelati's Spellbook is on Cooldown. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Summoning: Horror. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Summoning: Horrors
system: Spell. Can be used as a Counter. Roll a four-sided die. The number rolled is the number of Horrors summoned by Gilles (they will appear within a 5x5 panel area around Gilles). Counts as Gilles' Attack for the Turn. Horrors have 100 Health, 10 Agility, 5 Luck, Range=1, MOV=3 and Base Attack (STR) is 100, Detect=2 panels. Horrors have the 'Dark (Outsider)' Attribute. Horrors do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn. The same Horror can only Move/Attack once per Turn. When a Horror is defeated, Gilles Flips a Coin. If Heads, the defeated Horror turns into two new Horrors. This effect does not activate if the Horror was defeated with Light damage or an Attack that deals extra damage to 'Dark' or 'Outsider' Attribute Units. Enemy Units cannot Attack Gilles or his Master if there are any Horrors directly next to them. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Summoning: Elder Horror. Cannot be used if Prelati's Spellbook is on Cooldown. Cooldown: (Number of Horrors x ⅔◈) Turns.

name: Yata no Kagami: Hakkon Jourai・Dainisshō
system: Damage Spell. Can only be used when Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi・Yata no Kagami is Active. Hits a 7x7 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Tamamo; if the Region is Japan, it hits a 9x9 panel area instead. The effects are as follows, in order 1. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Poison, Nature damage. 2. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Disable for 1◈ Turns, Ice damage. 3. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Sap for 1◈ Turns, Wind damage. 4. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Shock for 1◈ Turns, Lightning damage. 5. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Slow for 1◈ Turns, Water damage. 6. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Immobilize for 1◈ Turns, Earth damage. 7. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Blind for 1◈ Turns, Light damage. 8. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Curse, Dark damage. 9. Then, deals 2x damage to all enemy Units within the Spell area and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns, Fire damage. When this Spell is used, Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi・Yata no Kagami is forcibly ended at the end of the Turn, and its Cooldown is increased by an additional 1◈ Turns. This Damage Spell is categorized as Noble Phantasm.

name: Jusō・Enten
system: Mantra: Fiery Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 25% extra damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Hyōten, Mitten, or Raitei is on Cooldown.

name: Fox's Wedding
system: (Active) Range=3. Used on an allied Unit. Has the following effects- 1. Restores its Health by 20% of its maximum value and restores its Luck by 3 (5 Luck instead if used on her Master). 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 30%. 3. If the affected Unit is Tamamo's Master or is Tamamo while her Master is within a 2 panel area of herself, apply the Fox Spouse buff to her Master for 1◈ Turns, the Master cannot be Overpowered and Underpowered by Servants. The 'Fox Spouse' buff is Unremovable. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Tokoyo Sakisaku Daisakkai・Higanbana Sesshoseki
system: Rank ?. Red Spider Lily Killing Stone. Range=1. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 2x damage. Has 2 extra effects depending on the DU's END Rank and MAG Rank. 1. Inflicts Stage X Curse on the DU, X being: MAG Rank EX, A: 1; B, C: 2; D, E: 3. 2. Inflicts Stage X Poison on the DU, X being: END Rank EX, A: 1; B, C: 2; D, E: 3. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Note: When this NP is used, Tamamo's Master loses Health equal to if a Rank E Noble Phantasm was used.

name: Jusō・Hyōten
system: Mantra: Frigid Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 25% extra damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Disable for 1◈ Turns. Ice damage. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Enten, Mitten, or Raitei is on Cooldown.

name: Jusō・Kokutendō
system: Mantra: Aphotic Cave. Spell. Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase when Attacked. Tamamo enters the Aphotic state for ⅓◈ Turns. This effect is neither a buff or a debuff and is Unremovable; the effects of the 'Aphotic' state are as follows- 1. Gains the Decoy effect. 2. Cannot Evade and Dodge/Substitution has no effect. 3. Tamamo automatically Blocks every Attack received. 4. All damage taken is reduced by 30%; if NP, 15%. 5. Whenever Tamamo is Attacked while in the 'Aphotic' State, at the end of the Damage Step, reduce her Spell Cooldown by ⅓◈ Turns (including this Spell!). If all Spells are not in Cooldown, then NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns. If all Spells and NP are not in Cooldown, then gain the Dmg Up (Aphotic) buff for 1 time, damage dealt by the next Attack which deals MAG damage is increased by 15% including NP. Dmg Up (Aphotic) can stack and is Unremovable. This Spell cannot be used if Tamamo is already in the 'Aphotic' state. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.

name: Jusō・Kōnisshō
system: Mantra: Boundless Sunlight. Spell. Used during your Turn. Range=3. Used on an enemy Unit within Range, increases its NP Cooldown by 3◈ Turns (cannot exceed max Cooldown in this way), then Tamamo gains 2 Mantra Tokens. After that, apply NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns to all other allied Units within a 2 panel area around Tamamo, NP damage dealt is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Jusō・Kūretsu Daimitten
system: Mantra: Void Cleft Great Chaos Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 2x damage with a 75% chance of inflicting Stun for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Jusō・Mitten
system: Mantra: Chaos Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 25% extra damage that has the Pierce effect and Break (+50%dm) effect. Wind damage. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Enten, Hyōten, or Raitei is on Cooldown.

name: Polygamist Castration Fist
system: Attack Skill. Range=2. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 3x damage. If the Unit is Male, deal 9x damage instead, and has a 90% chance of inflicting Stun (Balls) for 1◈ Turns if damage was dealt- Not affected by any effects which modify chance of inflicting/receiving debuffs as well as Debuff Immune, even those which specifically resist Bind effects. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Jusō・Raitei
system: Mantra: Thunderclap. Damage Spell. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 25% extra damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Tamamo cannot be within the Spell area. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Enten, Hyōten, or Mitten is on Cooldown.

name: Shapeshift
system: (Passive) All damage taken is reduced by 30%; if NP, 15%.

name: Witchcraft
system: (Passive 1) Tamamo's Attacks which use Base Attack (MAG) ignore Magic Resistance. Negated while affected by Skill Seal or Silence. (Passive 2) When Tamamo uses a Mantra Spell other than Jusō: Kōnisshō, Jusō・Kokutendō, and Jusō・Kūretsu Daimitten while she has any Mantra Tokens, remove one Mantra Token from herself and the Mantra Spell that she used does not enter Cooldown. The maximum number of Mantra Tokens Tamamo can have is 3.

name: Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi・Yata no Kagami
system: (Non-damaging) Eightfold Blessings of Amaterasu on the Weight Stone under the Sunlit Watery Heavens. Affects a 5x5 panel area around Tamamo, this area will be termed as the 'Amaterasu Area'. Tamamo cannot leave the Amaterasu Area. Increases Tamamo's Range by 1 for the NP duration. If the Region is Japan, the Amaterasu Area is 7x7 instead, and Tamamo's Range is increased by 2. This NP has the following effects- 1. All allied Units within the Amaterasu Area upon activation have their Health and Agility and Luck restored by 30% of their maximum values. 2. Reduces Skill, Spell, and NP Cooldown of all allied Units within the Amaterasu Area upon activation by 1◈ Turns (excluding this NP's own Cooldown). 3. Increases damage dealt by all allied Units within the Amaterasu Area. MAG damage dealt is increased by 100%, while STR damage dealt is increased by 50%. Applies to Noble Phantasm as well. 4. Allied Masters' ZON do not apply to their Servants within the Amaterasu Area. 5. The Sustainability of allied Free Servants do not decrease when they are within the Amaterasu Area. 6. All effects of Servants that would reduce its Master's Health when used/it takes effect is halved including Noble Phantasm usage. 7. The maximum number of Mantra Tokens she can hold is increased to 6, then she gains Mantra Tokens up to the maximum amount. 8. Tamamo's Divinity Skill becomes activated. 9. If Tamamo is defeated, this NP is forcefully ended at the end of the Turn. This Noble Phantasm lasts for 2◈ Turns (3◈ Turns if the Region is Japan). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns after it ends.

name: Yata Strike
system: Attack Skill. Can be used instead of a Normal Attack and is categorized as one. Range=2. Deals 10 Fixed STR damage, Total Damage dealt is multiplied by X, X = the number rolled on an eight-sided die. 1. For every time this Attack Skill does not Crit, increase the Crit Chance of this Attack Skill by 10%. Reset the counter after it Crits. 2. If this Attack Skill is a Crit, it deals 15 STR damage instead of 10.

name: Bloodsucking
system: (Active) Range=1. Used on an enemy Unit. Increase its NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns, and reduce Vlad's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns. If Mad Enhancement is Active, the Range of this Skill is increased by 1, but the chance of increasing the DU's NP Cooldown is reduced by 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: Fearsome Immortal
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts (Fearsome) to Vlad for ⅓◈ Turns, when Vlad is defeated he is revived with 20% of his Max Health. This Guts buff stacks with other normal Guts buffs. 2. Applies Guts to Vlad for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, when Vlad is defeated he is revived with 20% of his Max Health. 3. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Kazıklı Bey: Bloodstained King Demon
system: Range=3. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 3.5x damage plus 100 and inflicts Curse on the DU. Then, has the following effects- 1. Inflicts Def Dwn (A) for 1◈ Turns to the DU, all damage taken is increased by 20%; and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. 2. Applies S.Crit Up to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 10%. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.

name: Legend of Dracula: The Succession of Blood
system: (Passive) Applies the following effects to Vlad- 1. Applies the 'Dark (Vampire)' Attribute to Vlad. 2. Vlad restores 100 Health and 1 Agility at the end of any Turn he Acts during a Night Round. 3. Every time Vlad deals damage to a Unit, he heals 100 Health and 1 Agility. Each time he kills a non-Civilian Unit, his Health and Agility is restored by 25% of their maximum values. (Active/Non-damaging) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. If Vlad has the Def Up (Shapeshift) buff and/or the Atk Up (Shapeshift) buff, the duration of those buffs is extended by 1◈ Turns. 2. Vlad gains the Dracula effect for 1◈ Turns, its effects are as follows- Doubles the magnitude of 'Shapeshift's' Passive effect, the Def Up (Shapeshift) buff, and the Atk Up (Shapeshift) buff. The 'Dracula' effect is neither a buff or debuff and is Unremovable (see the next line for the exception). 3. If this Skill is used during a 'Day' Round, Vlad does not gain the 'Dracula' effect. If the Round changes from Night to Day while Vlad has the 'Dracula' effect, it is removed from him at the start of the Day Round. 4. Applies Atk Up (Shapeshift) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 10%; if NP, 5%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Does not consume his Master's Health as a cost when used.

name: Shapeshift
system: (Passive 1) Reduces all damage received by 10%; if NP, 5%. (Active) Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Process when Vlad is Attacked. Applies Def Up (Shapeshift) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is further reduced by 10%; if NP, 5%. Def Up (Shapeshift) does not stack. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. (Passive 2) If this Skill is used while Vlad has any Def Up (Shapeshift) and/or Atk Up (Shapeshift) buffs, their duration is reset to 1◈ Turns.

name: Demonic Defender of the State
system: (Passive) When Vlad III (Lancer) is summoned, the player with Vlad marks out a 9x9 panel area on the half of the board nearer to or around Vlad's Home Base. This area cannot intersect the Home Base of other Players. This area will be known as 'Wallachia'. Has the following effects- 1. As long as Vlad is within Wallachia, all damage taken is reduced by 50%; if NP, 25%. 2. As long as Vlad is within Wallachia, all STR damage dealt is increased by 100% including NP; if MAG damage, 50%. 3. Vlad's Sustainability does not decrease as long as he is within Wallachia, and his Master's ZON is ignored. 4. Wallachia functions as a second Home Base for Vlad only. On panels where his actual Home Base and Wallachia overlap, the end-of-the-Round healing does not stack. Note: If Wallachia would intersect the Home Base of another Player no matter where it is placed, then the shape of the Wallachia area is reduced to exclude panels which would intersect the Home Base of another Player.

name: Kazıklı Bey (Execution)
system: (Active 2) Used during your Turn, or at the start or end of a Combat Process involving Vlad. Affects all Units with Kazıklı stacks within a 3 panel area of himself. Those Units receive Y damage, where Y being 50 * the number of Kazıklı stacks on each Unit respectively; then inflict Curse to the affected Units, and remove all Kazıklı stacks from the affected Units. This damage has the Pierce and Ignore Def effects. Counts as Vlad's Attack for the Turn if used during his Turn. If this NP is used within the Wallachia, Y is 100 * the number of Kazıklı stacks on the respective affected Units who are also within Wallachia (those outside of it use the original calculation instead, if any). If this NP is used at the start of a Combat Process where Vlad is receiving the Attack; the AU's Attack is cancelled, then Vlad can Counter if the enemy Unit is within Range. If this NP is used at the end of a Combat Process where Vlad performed the Attack; the DU cannot Counter Vlad's Attack. Can only be used once per Round. Does not reduce his Master's Health as a cost when used. Note: Damage from this NP is not affected by any damage-modifying effects on Vlad.

name: Kazıklı Bey: The Lord of Execution
system: (Passive) Whenever Vlad successfully deals damage to a Unit with a Normal Attack, apply one Kazıklı stack to the DU at the end of the Damage Step. Kazıklı stacks are categorized as a debuff, the chance of a Kazıklı stack being removed is reduced by 50%. (Active 1) Used during your Turn. This Noble Phantasm can only be used within Wallachia. When this Noble Phantasm is used, it becomes Activated for ⅔◈ Turns and has the following effects- While Kazıklı Bey is Activated, at the end of every Turn Vlad Acts and at the end of the Round, all enemy Units within the NP area roll a six-sided die respectively. They will then respectively receive X STR damage, X being the number rolled * 100, if the NP is not Evaded. Damaged Units will then be inflicted with Curse. This NP is able to damage Masters even if their respective Servant is within a 2 panel area of them. Damage from this NP has the Ignore Def effect and also ignores Block, but Units with the Invuln and Anti-Purge buffs will not take damage. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns. (Active 2) Kazıklı Bey (Execution). Note: Damage from both (Active 1) and (Active 2) of this NP are not affected by any damage-modifying effects on Vlad.

name: Legend of Dracula: The Succession of Blood
system: (Activation/Passive) In order to use this Noble Phantasm, Vlad's Master has to use a Command Spell. However, if the Master is within Wallachia when it is activated, Vlad will immediately kill his Master after this NP is activated. Cannot be deactivated after it is used. Permanently applies the following effects to Vlad- 1. Vlad gains the 'Dark (Vampire)' Attribute. 2. During a Night Round, Vlad heals 100 Health and 1 Agility at the end of his Turn, at the end of any Turn he Acts, and at the end of the Round. 3. Each time Vlad deals damage to a Unit, he heals 100 Health and 1 Agility (no effect if no damage is dealt). Each time he defeats a Unit, his Health and Agility is restored by 25% of their maximum values. However, if he defeats a Civilian, he only heals 100 Health and 1 Agility. 4. The magnitude of Shapeshift is doubled. 5. Kazıklı Bey is unusable and has no effects. Magic Resistance is disabled. 6. Vlad will always Attack (and Move towards) the closest Unit, including allied Units. 7. Range is increased by 1 panel, and number of targets is increased by 1. Vlad can Move to any unoccupied panel while Moving, regardless of obstacles (but still cannot enter the area around an enemy Master). 8. Base Attack (STR) is increased by 75. 9. Whenever Vlad performs an Evade roll, reduce the value rolled by 4. Does not affect non-Evade Agility Checks. 10. Total Fire damage taken is increased by 25%. See Legend of Dracula (Activated).

name: Shapeshift
system: (Passive) All damage taken is reduced by 10%; if NP, 5%. (Active) Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase when Vlad is Attacked. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is further reduced by 10%; if NP, 5%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

name: [Vorpal Blade]
system: When Equipped, increase the Unit's Base Attack (STR) by 50, but Range is reduced to 1 panel; and Normal Attack damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute is increased by 50%. The above Stat boosts do not affect NP & Attacks Categorized as NP. Normal Attacks with this Item Equipped use Base Attack (STR). A Master with this Item Equipped cannot be Underpowered by Servants. When the Jabberwock is Attacked by this Equipped Item, it receives 3x damage instead of 50% extra damage due to having the 'Demonic' Attribute, and the lifesteal effect is permanently removed from the Jabberwock; then the Vorpal Blade breaks and can no longer be used. Cannot be obtained by Nursery or her Master.

name: Doppelganger
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. When this Skill is used, Yan Qing can disguise himself as any other character (figurine), including Masters and Servants. However, it is only the appearance. All of Yan Qing's Parameters and Stats remain the same. Skills and Noble Phantasms except Presence Concealment cannot be used while Doppelganger is Active. Can be deactivated at any time; and is automatically deactivated when Yan Qing takes damage equal to 10% of his Max Health or more in one Attack. When Doppelganger is manually deactivated by Yan Qing, apply the following effects to himself- 1. Restore 3 Agility. 2. Apply Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30% after calculation; if NP, 20%. 3. Apply Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 30%. 4. Apply Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30% after calculation. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns after deactivation. Note: Espionage cannot be used if Doppelganger is Active and vice versa.

name: Espionage
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 40%. 2. Applies the Espionage buff for 1◈ Turns, Yan Qing's Presence Concealment Rank is increased from C to A. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Yan Qing Fist
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 60%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Lawful) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Lawful' Alignment is increased by 30%. 3. Applies Dmg Up (Evil) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Evil' Alignment is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.

name: Shí Miàn Mái Fú: Xíng Rú Wú Yǐng
system: Ambushed from Ten Sides - As If There Was No Shadow. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 5x damage, then roll 2 four-sided dice and apply the following effects, depending on the numbers rolled- 1. Inflict Def Dwn (C) for 1◈ Turns on the DU, all damage taken is increased by 20%; and Agility is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. 2. Inflict Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns on the DU, Crit Chance is reduced by 40%. 3. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns to himself, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 50%. If the second die is a duplicate number, reroll it until the number is not a duplicate. If a 4 is rolled on any of the dice, apply all three effects instead. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.

name: Ruffian
system: (Passive 1) Crit Damage dealt is increased by 15%. (Passive 2) Whenever Yan Qing deals damage with an Attack, he can spend X Agility to increase the damage dealt. For every Agility point spent in this way, damage dealt is increased by 5%. Cannot be used with Noble Phantasm.

name: Skillful Star
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Inflicts Crit Dwn on himself for this Turn, Crit Chance is reduced by 50%; then apply S.Crit Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself except himself, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns.

name: Zhōng Guó Quán Fǎ
system: (Passive) Chinese Boxing. Crit Chance is increased by 15%. Whenever Yan Qing deals damage with a Normal Attack, reduce his NP Cooldown by 1 Turns at the end of the Combat Process (2 Turns if ◈ is greater than 4).

name: Alter Ego
system: (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Outsider' Attribute and/or the 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill is increased by 50% including NP. All damage received from Units with the 'Outsider' Attribute and/or the 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill is reduced by 50% including NP.

name: Avenger
system: (Passive) All damage taken by this Servant is increased including NP. If this Servant Counters after receiving an Attack, the damage dealt when Countering is increased by the same amount including NP.

name: Battle Continuation
holders: Achilles, Cú Chulainn, Heracles, Vlad III (Berserker), Vlad III (Lancer)
system: (Passive 1) All damage received is reduced by the table roll; if NP, the number of dice rolled is doubled. (Passive 2) When this Unit is defeated, it is automatically revived. Requires the Unit's Health to have exceeded half its maximum at least once since the last activation.

name: Bravery
system: (Passive) Chance of being inflicted with Mental Debuffs is reduced by 50%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up (STR) for 1◈ Turns, STR damage dealt is increased by 25%; if NP, 15%.

name: Divinity
rank: C / B / A / E- / EX / B+
holders: Achilles, Arjuna, Chiron, Cú Chulainn, Heracles, Karna, Mannanán mac Lir, Medusa, Nemo, Ozymandias, Penthesilea, Proto Gil, Raikou, Rama, Semiramis, Tamamo, U-Olga Marie, Van Gogh
system: All damage dealt is increased by the table value, including NP.

name: Existence Outside The Domain
system: (Passive) Has the following effects on Van Gogh- 1. Chance of being inflicted by debuffs including Instakill is reduced by 25%, this effect is halved for Death (10%) and further halved for Erase (5%). 2. All damage received from Units with the 'Mad Enhancement' Skill is reduced by 40% including NP; all damage dealt to those Units is increased by 40% including NP. 3. All damage received from Units with the 'Existence Outside The Domain' Skill or the 'Outsider' Attribute is increased by 40% including NP. 4. Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 5. When a Unit with Active Mad Enhancement Attacks this Unit, the damage boosting effect of Mad Enhancement is negated. When this Unit Attacks a Unit with Active Mad Enhancement, the damage reducing effect of Mad Enhancement is negated.

name: God's Resolution
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Inflicts Stun for 1◈ Turns. Ignores Stun Resist, Stun Immune, and any other effects that specifically reduce the chance of being inflicted with Stun.

name: Independent Action with Viy
system: (Passive 1) Sustainability does not apply. (Passive 2) Master's ZON is increased by 3 panels. (Passive 3) Cannot be contracted by enemy Casters and Masters. (Passive 4) Crit Chance is increased by 10%. Crit Damage dealt is increased by 10%.

name: Independent Action
rank: A / B / A+ / C / EX / D
holders: Arjuna, Chiron, EMIYA, Gray, Kingprotea, Kiritsugu, Medusa, Proto Gil, Hassan of Serenity, Sieg, Sita, U-Olga Marie
system: (Passive 1) Has a high Sustainability. (Passive 2) Master's ZON is increased by @rank's table value in panels. (Passive 3) Requires several successful 'Contract Servant' rolls to be contracted by enemy Masters and Casters; at A+ and EX, it cannot be contracted by an enemy at all.

name: Item Construction
holders: Summer Habetrot, U-Olga Marie, Van Gogh
system: (Passive) Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of this Unit. 1. The chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by 35%; this effect is halved for Instakill (15%), and further halved for Death (5%). 2. The chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 35%; Instakill 15%, Death 5%. If a Unit is affected by multiple instances of this Skill, only the Item Construction with the highest Rank takes effect.

name: Mad Enhancement
holders: Asterios, Castor, Gilles de Rais (Saber), Heracles, Kingprotea, Penthesilea, Raikou, Vlad III (Berserker)
system: (Active) While Active- 1. This Servant's Master loses Health at the end of every Turn it Acts; when the Master's Health is at or below that amount, Mad Enhancement is forcibly deactivated, and until it may be deactivated the Master's Health cannot drop below it in this way. 2. All damage taken is reduced; a smaller reduction applies to NP. 3. All damage dealt is increased including NP; halved for Base Attack (MAG). 4. MOV +2, Range +1, the Master's ZON +2. 5. Sustainability is reduced by 2◈ if its Master is defeated while Active. 6. This Servant can only Evade with Evade−. 7. The effects are neither a buff nor a debuff, and are Unremovable.

name: Magic Resistance (weakness)
system: (Passive) Against MAG damage from an Attack that deals extra damage to @vsAttribute Units, Magic Resistance only negates damage from a MAG Rank of up to @rank, otherwise MAG damage taken is reduced by @percent%. Also affects NP.

name: Magic Resistance
holders: Achilles, Arjuna, Arturia, Chiron, Cú Chulainn, Francis Drake, EMIYA, Gilles de Rais (Saber), Gray, Karl de Große, Karna, Arturia (Lancer), Mannanán mac Lir, Medusa, Ozymandias, Pale Rider, Pollux, Proto Gil, Quetzalcoatl, Raikou, Rama, Scáthach, Sita, U-Olga Marie, Vlad III (Lancer)
system: (Passive 1) MAG damage from a MAG Rank of up to @rank is negated, otherwise MAG damage taken is reduced by the table value. Also affects NP. (Passive 2) Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced. Also affects Instakill and Death UNLESS the source deals STR damage or is otherwise unaffected by Magic Resistance. Erase is completely unaffected.

name: Oblivion Correction
system: (Passive) Crit Chance is increased.

name: Presence Concealment
holders: Hundred-Faced Hassan, Jack the Ripper, Katō Danzō, Kiritsugu, Semiramis, Hassan of Serenity, Yan Qing
system: (Active) Used during your Turn. The effects of this Skill last for 2◈ Turns. 1. This Unit cannot be targeted for an Attack or an enemy Unit's Skill. If it is caught in an AoE Attack and fails to Evade, Flip a Coin. If Heads, no damage and effects are received; if Tails, Total Damage taken from that Attack is reduced by 50% and PC is deactivated. 2. This Unit's Attacks cannot be Blocked or Countered unless the Defending Unit's current AGI Rank is equal to or higher than it. If the DU Evades, the Evade Roll is increased by the rank table value. 3. This Unit is able to Attack Masters and Move to any panel regardless of enemy Master-Servant positions. 4. All damage dealt is increased by 100%; if NP, 50%. Does not apply to Masters. 5. After performing an Attack while PC is Active, PC is deactivated at the end of the Combat Process. 6. When this Unit Moves into an enemy Servant's Range (or Detect), it has the rank table's chance of being discovered. 7. Active Skills targeting or affecting an enemy Unit cannot be used unless stated. Does not include Attack Skills and Spells that deal damage. 8. The effects of Presence Concealment are neither a buff nor a debuff, and are Unremovable. Cooldown: the rank table's value, counted from deactivation.

name: Pretender: The One who Wears a Role
system: (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Alter-Ego' Skill is increased by 50% and all damage taken from them is reduced by 50%; applies to NP as well. All damage dealt to Units with the 'Outsider' Attribute and/or 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill is reduced by 50% and all damage taken from them is increased by 50%; applies to NP as well. (Active) Used during your Turn. First, this Unit chooses a standard Servant Class. Apply the 'Pretender (>X)' effect to itself for 2◈ Turns, where X is the chosen Servant Class; its effects are as follows- All damage dealt to the selected Servant Class is increased by 50% and all damage taken from them is reduced by 50%; applies to NP as well.
